local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local baseline
local connections={}
local elapsed=0
local roll=0
local shift=0
local lastCamera
local lastBase
local lastOutput
local beforeName="BritishBulldogCameraRestore"
local afterName="BritishBulldogCameraMotion"

local function removeCameraOffset()
 if lastCamera and lastCamera.Parent and lastBase and lastOutput and lastCamera.CFrame==lastOutput then
  lastCamera.CFrame=lastBase
 end
 lastCamera=nil
 lastBase=nil
 lastOutput=nil
end

local function restore()
 removeCameraOffset()
 roll=0
 shift=0
 if not baseline then return end
 player.CameraMinZoomDistance=math.min(baseline.minimum,player.CameraMaxZoomDistance)
 player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=baseline.maximum
 player.CameraMinZoomDistance=baseline.minimum
 player.CameraMode=baseline.mode
 baseline=nil
end

local function update()
 local active=player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating")==true
  or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating")==true
  or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true )
 if not active then restore() return end
 if not baseline then
  baseline={minimum=player.CameraMinZoomDistance,maximum=player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,mode=player.CameraMode}
 end
 player.CameraMode=Enum.CameraMode.Classic
 if player.CameraMinZoomDistance~=0.5 then player.CameraMinZoomDistance=0.5 end
 if player.CameraMaxZoomDistance~=25 then player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=25 end
end

local function numberAttribute(name,fallback)
 local value=player:GetAttribute(name)
 return typeof(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge and value or fallback
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep(beforeName,Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value-1,removeCameraOffset)
RunService:BindToRenderStep(afterName,Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,function(dt)
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local character=player.Character
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local state=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogState")
 local active=player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating")==true and state and state:GetAttribute("Phase")=="Crossing"
  and player:GetAttribute("BBRole")~="Tagged" and player:GetAttribute("BBStatus")~="Safe"
  and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and root and humanoid.WalkSpeed>0
 if not camera or camera.CameraType~=Enum.CameraType.Custom then roll=0 shift=0 return end
 local targetRoll=0
 local targetShift=0
 if active and player:GetAttribute("PCReducedMotion")~=true then
  local screenRight=camera.CFrame.RightVector
  local lateral=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(screenRight)
  targetRoll=-math.rad(1.2)*math.clamp(lateral/math.max(humanoid.WalkSpeed,1),-1,1)
  local started=numberAttribute("BBDodgeStartedAt",0)
  local duration=math.clamp(numberAttribute("BBDodgeDuration",0.32),0.2,0.5)+0.14
  local time=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-started
  local direction=player:GetAttribute("BBDodgeDirection")
  if started>0 and time>=0 and time<duration and typeof(direction)=="Vector3" then
   local alpha=time/duration
   local pulse=alpha<0.22 and math.sin(alpha/0.22*math.pi/2) or math.cos((alpha-0.22)/0.78*math.pi/2)^2
   local side=math.clamp(direction:Dot(screenRight),-1,1)
   targetRoll-=math.rad(3.2)*side*pulse
   targetShift=0.24*side*pulse
  end
 end
 local blend=1-math.exp(-18*math.clamp(dt,0,0.1))
 roll+=(targetRoll-roll)*blend
 shift+=(targetShift-shift)*blend
 if not active and math.abs(roll)<0.0001 and math.abs(shift)<0.0001 then roll=0 shift=0 return end
 if roll==0 and shift==0 then return end
 lastCamera=camera
 lastBase=camera.CFrame
 lastOutput=lastBase*CFrame.new(shift,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,roll)
 camera.CFrame=lastOutput
end)

for _,attribute in ipairs({"BBParticipating","TGParticipating","MDParticipating", "HSParticipating"}) do
 table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(update))
end
table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt
 if elapsed>=0.2 then elapsed=0 update() end
end))
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
 RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(beforeName)
 RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(afterName)
 for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
 restore()
end)
update()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local baseline
local activeProfile
local elapsed = 0
local profiles = {
	Lobby = {
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 122, 136),
		OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(132, 145, 154),
		Brightness = 2.2, ExposureCompensation = 0, ClockTime = 13.5,
	},
	School = {
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 108, 102),
		OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(132, 129, 120),
		Brightness = 1.5, ExposureCompensation = -0.05, ClockTime = 13.5,
	},
}
local function restore()
	if baseline then
		for name, value in pairs(baseline) do Lighting[name] = value end
	end
	baseline, activeProfile = nil, nil
end
local function within(bounds, position)
	if not bounds or not bounds:IsA("BasePart") or not position then return false end
	local point = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = bounds.Size / 2
	return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z
end
local function boundsFor(name, partName)
	local model = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
	local gameplay = model and model:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
	return gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild(partName)
end
local function update()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local schoolBounds = boundsFor("Hide and Seek", "ArenaBounds")
	local inSchool = within(schoolBounds, camera and camera.CFrame.Position)
		or (player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") and within(schoolBounds, root and root.Position))
	local profile
	if inSchool then
		profile = "School"
	elseif within(boundsFor("Playground Lobby", "LobbyBounds"), root and root.Position)
		and not player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating")
		and not player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") and not player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") then
		profile = "Lobby"
	end
	if not profile then restore() return end
	if profile == activeProfile then return end
	if not baseline then
		baseline = {
			Ambient = Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
			Brightness = Lighting.Brightness, ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation, ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
		}
	end
	for name, value in pairs(profiles[profile]) do Lighting[name] = value end
	activeProfile = profile
end
local heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed >= 0.3 then elapsed = 0 update() end
end)
script.Destroying:Connect(function() heartbeat:Disconnect() restore() end)
update()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local records = {}
local function restore(record)
	for joint, entry in pairs(record.joints) do
		if joint.Parent and joint.Transform == entry.applied then joint.Transform = entry.original end
	end
	table.clear(record.joints)
end
local function pose(record, joint, offset)
	if not joint or not (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then return end
	local previous = record.joints[joint]
	local original = joint.Transform
	if previous and original == previous.applied then original = previous.original end
	joint.Transform = original * offset
	record.joints[joint] = { original = original, applied = joint.Transform }
end
local bodyNames = {
	"HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "LowerTorso", "UpperTorso", "Head",
	"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand",
	"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot",
	"Right Arm", "Left Arm", "Right Leg", "Left Leg",
}
local function collectJoints(character)
	local joints = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(bodyNames) do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Motor6D") or child:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then joints[child.Name] = child end
			end
		end
	end
	return joints
end
local function bodyJoints(record, character, now)
	if not record.bodyJoints or now - (record.jointsAt or -math.huge) >= 0.5 then
		record.bodyJoints = collectJoints(character)
		record.jointsAt = now
	end
	return record.bodyJoints
end
local function vector(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x, y, z) end
local batPoses = {
	{ time = 0, r6 = vector(90, 0, -8), r15 = vector(65, 0, -8), elbow = 25,
		wrist = vector(0, 0, 0), root = vector(0, 0, 0), waist = vector(0, 0, 0),
		guide = vector(75, -30, 16), guideElbow = 48, guideWeight = 0, bodyWeight = 0 },

		wrist = vector(-6, -12, -8), root = vector(3, -16, -3), waist = vector(2, -19, -2),
		guide = vector(106, -60, 10), guideElbow = 15, guideWeight = 1, bodyWeight = 1 },

	{ time = 0.30, r6 = vector(74, 84, -24), r15 = vector(54, 80, -19), elbow = 33,
		wrist = vector(8, 13, 10), root = vector(-2, 18, 5), waist = vector(-1, 23, 3),
		guide = vector(53, -8, 15), guideElbow = 35, guideWeight = 0.5, bodyWeight = 1 },
	{ time = 0.365, r6 = vector(88, 62, -18), r15 = vector(65, 56, -15), elbow = 37,
		wrist = vector(4, 8, 4), root = vector(0, 13, 3), waist = vector(0, 15, 2),
		guide = vector(41, -4, 9), guideElbow = 28, guideWeight = 0.25, bodyWeight = 0.65 },
	{ time = 0.48, r6 = vector(90, 0, -8), r15 = vector(65, 0, -8), elbow = 25,
		wrist = vector(0, 0, 0), root = vector(0, 0, 0), waist = vector(0, 0, 0),
		guide = vector(75, -30, 16), guideElbow = 48, guideWeight = 0, bodyWeight = 0 },
}
local function tangent(index, key)
	if index == 1 or index == #batPoses then return batPoses[index][key] * 0 end
	local before, current, after = batPoses[index - 1], batPoses[index], batPoses[index + 1]
	local incoming = (current[key] - before[key]) / (current.time - before.time)
	local outgoing = (after[key] - current[key]) / (after.time - current.time)
	return (incoming + outgoing) * 0.35
end
local function sampleBatPose(elapsed, classic)
	local first = batPoses[1]
	if elapsed < 0 or elapsed >= 0.48 then elapsed = 0 end
	local index = 2
	while index < #batPoses and elapsed > batPoses[index].time do index += 1 end
	local start, finish = batPoses[index - 1], batPoses[index]
	local duration = finish.time - start.time
	local t = math.clamp((elapsed - start.time) / duration, 0, 1)
	local t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
	local result = {}
	for key, value in pairs(first) do
		if key ~= "time" then
			result[key] = start[key] * (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1)
				+ tangent(index - 1, key) * duration * (t3 - 2 * t2 + t)
				+ finish[key] * (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2)
				+ tangent(index, key) * duration * (t3 - t2)
		end
	end
	result.shoulder = result[classic and "r6" or "r15"]
	result.guideWeight = math.clamp(result.guideWeight, 0, 1)
	result.bodyWeight = math.clamp(result.bodyWeight, 0, 1)
	return result
end
local function weaponJoint(record, joint, angles, weight, additive)
	if not joint or not joint.Parent or weight <= 0
		or not (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) or not joint.Enabled then return end
	local previous = record.joints[joint]
	local original = joint.Transform
	if previous and original == previous.applied then original = previous.original end
	local basis = joint.C0.Rotation
	local rotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(math.rad(angles.X), math.rad(angles.Y), math.rad(angles.Z))
	local target = basis:Inverse() * rotation * basis
	if additive then target = original * target end
	joint.Transform = original:Lerp(target, math.clamp(weight, 0, 1))
	record.joints[joint] = { original = original, applied = joint.Transform }
end
local function applyBatPose(record, joints, sampled, classic, fade)
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Right Shoulder" or "RightShoulder"], sampled.shoulder, fade)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.RightElbow, vector(sampled.elbow, 0, 0), fade)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.RightWrist, sampled.wrist, fade)
	local guide = sampled.guideWeight * fade
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Left Shoulder" or "LeftShoulder"], sampled.guide, guide)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.LeftElbow, vector(sampled.guideElbow, 0, 0), guide)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.LeftWrist, vector(0, 10, -8), guide)
	local root = sampled.root * (classic and 1 or 0.55)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.RootJoint or joints.Root, root, fade, true)
	if not classic then weaponJoint(record, joints.Waist, sampled.waist, fade, true) end
	local chest = root + (classic and Vector3.zero or sampled.waist)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.Neck, vector(-chest.X * 0.4, -chest.Y * 0.6, -chest.Z * 0.5), fade, true)
	local weight = sampled.bodyWeight
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Right Hip" or "RightHip"],
		vector(-root.X + 2 * weight, -root.Y * 0.8, -root.Z), fade, true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Left Hip" or "LeftHip"],
		vector(-root.X - 2 * weight, -root.Y * 0.8, -root.Z), fade, true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.RightKnee, vector(-3 * weight, 0, 0), fade, true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.LeftKnee, vector(-5 * weight, 0, 0), fade, true)
end
local function animateBat(record, player, character, humanoid, now)
	local gameName = character:GetAttribute("PCBatGame")
	local participating = (gameName == "BritishBulldog" and player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true)
		or (gameName == "TagYoureIt" and player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true)
		or (gameName == "HideAndSeek" and player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true)
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:GetAttribute("PCBatHeld") ~= true or not participating
		or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true then
		record.weapon = nil
		return false
	end
	if record.weapon ~= gameName then
		record.weapon = gameName
		record.weaponAt = now
		record.jointsAt = nil
	end
	local started = player:GetAttribute("PCBatSwingAt")
	local elapsed = typeof(started) == "number" and started == started and now - started or math.huge
	local classic = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
	local sampled = sampleBatPose(elapsed, classic)
	local fade = math.clamp((now - record.weaponAt) / 0.1, 0, 1)
	applyBatPose(record, bodyJoints(record, character, now), sampled, classic, fade)
	return true
end

local function sampleToyPose(id, action, elapsed)
	local idle = toyIdle[id]
	local definition = toyActions[id]
	if not idle or not definition then return nil end
	local track = toyTracks[action]
	local duration = action == definition.action and definition.duration or action == definition.alternateAction and definition.alternateDuration
	if not duration or not track or elapsed ~= elapsed or elapsed < 0 or elapsed >= duration then return idle end
	local index = 2
	while index < #track and elapsed > track[index].time do index += 1 end
	local before, after = track[index - 1], track[index]
	local alpha = math.clamp((elapsed - before.time) / (after.time - before.time), 0, 1)
	alpha = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
	local first = index == 2 and idle or before.pose
	local last = index == #track and idle or after.pose
	local sampled = {}
	for key, value in pairs(first) do sampled[key] = value + (last[key] - value) * alpha end
	return sampled
end
local function applyToyPose(record, joints, sampled, classic, fade)
	local right = sampled.right - vector(classic and 0 or sampled.elbow,0,0)
	local left = sampled.left - vector(classic and 0 or sampled.leftElbow,0,0)
	if classic then
		right += vector(-24,32,-12) * sampled.barrelLift
		left += vector(-23,-20,13) * sampled.barrelLift
	end
	local wrist = sampled.wrist + (classic and Vector3.zero or vector(45,80,38) * sampled.drinkTip)
	weaponJoint(record,joints[classic and "Right Shoulder" or "RightShoulder"],right,fade)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.RightElbow,vector(sampled.elbow,0,0),fade)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.RightWrist,wrist,fade)
	weaponJoint(record,joints[classic and "Left Shoulder" or "LeftShoulder"],left,fade*sampled.leftWeight)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.LeftElbow,vector(sampled.leftElbow,0,0),fade*sampled.leftWeight)
	local root = sampled.root * (classic and 1 or 0.55)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.RootJoint or joints.Root,root,fade,true)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.Waist,sampled.waist,fade,true)
	local chest = root + (classic and Vector3.zero or sampled.waist)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.Neck,vector(-chest.X*.35,-chest.Y*.5,-chest.Z*.4),fade,true)
	weaponJoint(record,joints[classic and "Right Hip" or "RightHip"],sampled.rightHip,fade,true)
	weaponJoint(record,joints[classic and "Left Hip" or "LeftHip"],sampled.leftHip,fade,true)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.RightKnee,vector(sampled.rightKnee,0,0),fade,true)
	weaponJoint(record,joints.LeftKnee,vector(sampled.leftKnee,0,0),fade,true)
end
local function animateToy(record, player, character, humanoid, now)
	local id = character:GetAttribute("PCToyHeld")
	if typeof(id) ~= "string" or not toyActions[id] or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true then
		record.toy = nil
		return false
	end
	if record.toy ~= id then
		record.toy = id
		record.toyAt = now
		record.jointsAt = nil
	end
	local started = player:GetAttribute("PCToyActionAt")
	local action = player:GetAttribute("PCToyAction")
	local matches = player:GetAttribute("PCToyActionItem") == id
	local elapsed = matches and typeof(started) == "number" and started == started and now - started or math.huge
	local sampled = sampleToyPose(id, action, elapsed)
	local fade = math.clamp((now-record.toyAt)/0.12,0,1)
	applyToyPose(record,bodyJoints(record,character,now),sampled,humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6,fade)
	return true
end
local function animateDodge(record, player, character, humanoid, now)
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true then return false end
	local prefix
	if player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("BBRole") == "Runner"
		and player:GetAttribute("BBStatus") == "Crossing" then prefix = "BB"
	elseif player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true then prefix = "TG" end
	if not prefix then return false end
	local states = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local state = states:FindFirstChild(prefix == "BB" and "BritishBulldogState" or "TagState")
	if not state or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= (prefix == "BB" and "Crossing" or "Playing") then return false end
	local started = player:GetAttribute(prefix .. "DodgeStartedAt")
	local duration = player:GetAttribute(prefix .. "DodgeDuration")
	local direction = player:GetAttribute(prefix .. "DodgeDirection")
	if typeof(started) ~= "number" or started ~= started or started <= 0 or typeof(duration) ~= "number"
		or duration ~= duration or duration < 0.15 or duration > 0.5 or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
	local elapsed = now - started
	duration += 0.14
	if elapsed < 0 or elapsed >= duration then return false end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return false end
	local side = math.clamp(root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction).X, -1, 1)
	if side ~= side then return false end
	local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
	local strength = alpha < 0.22 and math.sin(alpha / 0.22 * math.pi / 2)
		or math.cos((alpha - 0.22) / 0.78 * math.pi / 2)^2
	local joints = bodyJoints(record, character, now)
	local classic = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
	local lean = vector(-9, 8 * side, -26 * side)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.RootJoint or joints.Root, lean, strength * (classic and 1 or 0.65), true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints.Waist, lean, strength * 0.35, true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Right Shoulder" or "RightShoulder"], vector(-12,0,18), strength, true)
	weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Left Shoulder" or "LeftShoulder"], vector(-12,0,-18), strength, true)
	return true
end


local botRecords = {}
local function animatePracticeBots(now)
	local state = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("TagState")
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("TagPracticeBots")
	local playing = state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing"
	for character, record in pairs(botRecords) do
		restore(record)
		if not playing or not folder or character.Parent ~= folder then botRecords[character] = nil end
	end
	if not playing or not folder then return end
	for _, character in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then continue end
		local speed = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude
		if speed < 0.1 then continue end
		local record = botRecords[character]
		if not record then record = { character = character, joints = {} } botRecords[character] = record end
		local joints = bodyJoints(record, character, now)
		local classic = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
		local swing = math.sin(now * 10) * math.min(speed / 16, 1) * 24
		weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Right Hip" or "RightHip"], vector(swing,0,0), 1, true)
		weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Left Hip" or "LeftHip"], vector(-swing,0,0), 1, true)
		weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Right Shoulder" or "RightShoulder"], vector(-swing,0,0), 1, true)
		weaponJoint(record, joints[classic and "Left Shoulder" or "LeftShoulder"], vector(swing,0,0), 1, true)
	end
end

local catalogEmote
local lastEmoteSerial = 0
local retiredEmotes = {}

local function emoteAnimationId(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local digits = value:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
	if not digits or #digits > 18 or tonumber(digits) <= 0 then return nil end
	return value
end

local function emoteNumber(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function emoteStatus(status, message)
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("PCEmotePlaybackMessage", message or "")
		player:SetAttribute("PCEmotePlaybackStatus", status)
	end
end

local function disposeEmote(track, animation)
	if track then pcall(function() track:Destroy() end) end
	if animation then animation:Destroy() end
end

local function cleanRetiredEmotes(force)
	for index = #retiredEmotes, 1, -1 do
		local entry = retiredEmotes[index]
		if force or os.clock() >= entry.destroyAt then
			disposeEmote(entry.track, entry.animation)
			table.remove(retiredEmotes, index)
		end
	end
end

local function stopCatalogEmote(message, failed)
	local request = catalogEmote
	if not request then return end
	catalogEmote = nil
	request.expired = true
	if request.worker and coroutine.status(request.worker) ~= "dead" and request.worker ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, request.worker) end
	if request.track then
		pcall(function() request.track:Stop(0.12) end)
		table.insert(retiredEmotes, {track=request.track,animation=request.animation,destroyAt=os.clock()+0.2})
	else disposeEmote(nil, request.animation) end
	emoteStatus(failed and "failed" or "stopped", message)
end

local function emoteCanContinue(player, character, humanoid)
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
		or humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 or player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true then return false end
	if player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or character:GetAttribute("PCBatHeld") == true then return false end
	local toy = character:GetAttribute("PCToyHeld")
	if typeof(toy) == "string" and toy ~= "" then return false end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.08 or humanoid.Jump then return false end
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude > 1.5 then return false end
	local state = humanoid:GetState()
	return state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
		and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
		and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
end

local function updateCatalogEmote(now)
	cleanRetiredEmotes(false)
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	if not player then return end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local serial = player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteSerial")
	local expires = player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteUntil")
	if catalogEmote and (catalogEmote.character ~= character or serial ~= catalogEmote.serial
		or not emoteNumber(expires) or now >= expires or not emoteCanContinue(player, character, humanoid)
		or (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("PCToyActionAt")) or 0) > catalogEmote.startedAt) then
		stopCatalogEmote("Dance stopped")
	end
	if emoteNumber(serial) and serial > 0 and serial % 1 == 0 and serial ~= lastEmoteSerial then
		lastEmoteSerial = serial
		local asset = emoteAnimationId(player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteAnimationId"))
		local started = player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteStartedAt")
		if not asset or player:GetAttribute("PCEmoteRigType") ~= "R15" or not emoteNumber(started)
			or not emoteNumber(expires) or started > now + 0.5 or expires <= now or expires - started > 35
			or not emoteCanContinue(player, character, humanoid) then return end
		catalogEmote = {serial=serial,character=character,humanoid=humanoid,asset=asset,startedAt=started,loadAt=os.clock()}
		emoteStatus("loading", "Loading dance...")
	end
	local request = catalogEmote
	if not request then return end
	if os.clock() - request.loadAt > 8 and (not request.track or request.track.Length <= 0) then
		stopCatalogEmote("This dance couldn't load. Try playing it again.", true)
		return
	end
	if request.track then
		if request.track.Length > 0 then
			if not request.track.IsPlaying then stopCatalogEmote("Dance stopped")
			elseif not request.ready then request.ready = true emoteStatus("playing", "Move or jump to stop dancing") end
		end
		return
	end
	if request.loading then return end
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return end
	request.loading = true
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.Name = "PlaygroundCatalogEmote"
	animation.AnimationId = request.asset
	request.animation = animation
	request.worker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
		if catalogEmote ~= request or request.expired then
			if ok then disposeEmote(track, nil) end
			return
		end
		if not ok then stopCatalogEmote("This dance couldn't load. Try playing it again.", true) return end
		request.track = track
		local played = pcall(function()
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play(0.2)
		end)
		if not played then stopCatalogEmote("This dance couldn't play. Try again.", true) end
	end)
end


local petClipCache = {}
local function loadPetClips(name)
	if petClipCache[name] then return petClipCache[name] end
	local root = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundPetAnimations")
	local source = root and root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not source then return nil end
	local clips = {referenceScale = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("ReferenceScale")) or 1}
	for _, sequence in source:GetChildren() do
		if sequence:IsA("KeyframeSequence") and sequence:GetAttribute("NormalizedBoneTransforms") == true then
			local frames = {}
			for _, keyframe in sequence:GetKeyframes() do
				local poses = {}
				for _, pose in keyframe:GetChildren() do
					if pose:IsA("Pose") then poses[pose.Name] = pose.CFrame end
				end
				table.insert(frames, {time = keyframe.Time, poses = poses})
			end
			table.sort(frames, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
			if #frames >= 2 and frames[#frames].time > 0 then
				clips[sequence.Name] = {frames = frames, duration = frames[#frames].time}
			end
		end
	end
	if not clips.Idle then return nil end
	petClipCache[name] = clips
	return clips
end

local function petClipPose(clip, phase, boneName)
	local frames = clip.frames
	local time = phase * clip.duration
	local low, high = 1, #frames
	while low + 1 < high do
		local middle = math.floor((low + high) * 0.5)
		if frames[middle].time <= time then low = middle else high = middle end
	end
	local a, b = frames[low], frames[high]
	local from = a.poses[boneName] or CFrame.identity
	local to = b.poses[boneName] or from
	return from:Lerp(to, math.clamp((time - a.time) / math.max(b.time - a.time, 0.0001), 0, 1))
end

local function prepareAuthoredMotion(state)
	local name = state.model:GetAttribute("PCPetClipSet")
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return end
	local clips = loadPetClips(name)
	if not clips then return end
	state.authored = {clips = clips, bones = {}, phase = 0, scale = state.model:GetScale() / clips.referenceScale}
	for _, bone in state.model:GetDescendants() do
		if bone:IsA("Bone") then
			table.insert(state.authored.bones, {bone = bone, name = bone.Name, rest = bone.Transform})
		end
	end
end

local function updateAuthoredMotion(state, reducedMotion)
	local authored = state.authored
	local idle, fly = authored.clips.Idle, authored.clips.Fly or authored.clips.Idle
	local blend = state.model:GetAttribute("PCDisplayPet") == true and 0 or state.movement
	local phase = reducedMotion and 0.25 or authored.phase
	for _, entry in authored.bones do
		local transform = petClipPose(idle, phase, entry.name):Lerp(petClipPose(fly, phase, entry.name), blend)
		entry.bone.Transform = entry.rest * (transform.Rotation + transform.Position * authored.scale)
	end
end


local hoveringPets = { P23 = true, P25 = true, P28 = true, P35 = true }
local function prepareRigMotion(state)
	prepareAuthoredMotion(state)
	state.bones, state.skinBones = {}, {}
	local pivot = state.model:GetPivot()
	for _, bone in ipairs(state.model:GetDescendants()) do
		if bone:IsA("Bone") then
			local source = bone:FindFirstChild("PCSourceBone")
			if source and source:IsA("ObjectValue") and source.Value then
				table.insert(state.skinBones, { bone = bone, source = source.Value })
			elseif state.model:GetAttribute("PCProceduralPetRig") == true then
				local frame = bone.WorldCFrame
				table.insert(state.bones, {
					bone = bone, name = bone.Name, rest = bone.Transform,
					pitch = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(pivot.RightVector),
					yaw = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(pivot.UpVector),
					roll = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(pivot.LookVector),
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

local function updateRigMotion(state, reducedMotion)
	if state.authored then updateAuthoredMotion(state, reducedMotion) return end
	if not state.tracks.idle and not state.tracks.walk then
		local phase, movement = state.phase, state.movement
		local intensity = reducedMotion and 0 or 1
		for _, entry in ipairs(state.bones) do
			local name, pitch, yaw, roll = entry.name, 0, 0, 0
			local right = name:find("R") ~= nil
			if name == "Head" then
				pitch = math.sin(phase * 0.5) * 3
				yaw = math.sin(phase * 0.29) * 5
			elseif name == "Tail" then
				yaw = math.sin(phase * 0.8) * (7 + movement * 9)
				pitch = math.sin(phase * 0.4) * 3
			elseif name:find("Wing") then
				roll = math.sin(phase) * (hoveringPets[state.id] and 22 or 10) * (right and -1 or 1)
			elseif name:find("Leg") or name:find("Arm") then
				local offset = right and math.pi or 0
				if name:find("Back") then offset += math.pi end
				local number = tonumber(name:match("(%d+)$"))
				if number then offset += (number - 1) * math.pi end
				pitch = math.sin(phase + offset) * (2 + movement * 18)
			elseif name == "Body" then
				pitch = math.sin(phase * 0.5) * 1.5
			end
			entry.bone.Transform = entry.rest
				* CFrame.fromAxisAngle(entry.pitch, math.rad(pitch * intensity))
				* CFrame.fromAxisAngle(entry.yaw, math.rad(yaw * intensity))
				* CFrame.fromAxisAngle(entry.roll, math.rad(roll * intensity))
		end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(state.skinBones) do
		entry.bone.Transform = entry.source.Transform
	end
end

local petRigStates = {}
local petRigClock = 1
local function updatePetRigs(delta)
	petRigClock += delta
	if petRigClock >= 0.3 then
		petRigClock = 0
		local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("VIP-Dragon-Rigged-display")
		if display and display:IsA("Model") and display:GetAttribute("PCDisplayPet") == true and not petRigStates[display] then
			local state = {model = display, id = "P36", tracks = {}, movement = 0, phase = 0}
			prepareRigMotion(state)
			petRigStates[display] = state
		end
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundPetVisuals")
		if folder then
			for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if model:IsA("Model") and (model:GetAttribute("PCProceduralPetRig") == true or type(model:GetAttribute("PCPetClipSet")) == "string") and not petRigStates[model] then
					local userId = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("PetOwnerUserId")) or 0
					local state = {model = model, id = model:GetAttribute("CatalogId"), tracks = {}, movement = 0, phase = (userId % 97) * math.pi * 2 / 97}
					prepareRigMotion(state)
					petRigStates[model] = state
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local reducedMotion = Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PCReducedMotion") == true
	for model, state in pairs(petRigStates) do
		if not model.Parent then
			petRigStates[model] = nil
		else
			state.movement = math.clamp(tonumber(model:GetAttribute("PCPetMovement")) or 0, 0, 1)
			state.phase += delta * math.pi * 2 * (0.85 + state.movement * 1.75)
			if state.authored and not reducedMotion then
				local clips = state.authored.clips
				local blend = model:GetAttribute("PCDisplayPet") == true and 0 or state.movement
				local duration = clips.Idle.duration + ((clips.Fly or clips.Idle).duration - clips.Idle.duration) * blend
				state.authored.phase = (state.authored.phase + delta / duration) % 1
			end
			updateRigMotion(state, reducedMotion)
		end
	end
end

local outlineCandidates = {}
local knownHighlights = {}
local outlineConnections = {}
local outlineClock = 1

local function outlineCandidate(object)
	if object.ClassName == "Model" and object:GetAttribute("PCOutlineStored") == true and object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		outlineCandidates[object] = true
		local outline = object:FindFirstChild("CartoonOutline")
		if outline and outline:IsA("Highlight") then outline:SetAttribute("PCCosmeticManaged", true) end
	end
end

local function observeOutlineObject(object)
	if object:IsA("Highlight") then knownHighlights[object] = true end
	outlineCandidate(object)
end

for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do observeOutlineObject(object) end
table.insert(outlineConnections, game.DescendantAdded:Connect(observeOutlineObject))
table.insert(outlineConnections, game.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
	knownHighlights[object] = nil
end))

local function clearCosmeticOutline(model)
	local outline = model:FindFirstChild("CartoonOutline")
	if outline and outline:IsA("Highlight") and outline:GetAttribute("PCCosmeticManaged") == true then outline:Destroy() end
end

local function updateCartoonOutlines()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local external = 0
	for highlight in pairs(knownHighlights) do
		if not highlight.Parent then knownHighlights[highlight] = nil
		elseif highlight:GetAttribute("PCCosmeticManaged") ~= true then external += 1 end
	end
	local budget = math.clamp(239 - external, 0, 128)
	local candidates = {}
	for model in pairs(outlineCandidates) do
		if not model.Parent or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			clearCosmeticOutline(model)
			outlineCandidates[model] = nil
		elseif model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineEnabled") ~= false then
			local position = model:GetPivot().Position
			local distance = (position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
			local _, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
			local owner = model:GetAttribute("PetOwnerUserId")
			local heldItem = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") ~= nil
			local localItem = owner == localPlayer.UserId or (localPlayer.Character and model:IsDescendantOf(localPlayer.Character))
			local score = localItem and -10000 or distance + (onScreen and 0 or 2000)
			if owner or heldItem then score -= 100 end
			table.insert(candidates, {model = model, score = score})
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.score < b.score end)
	local wanted = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(budget, #candidates) do wanted[candidates[index].model] = true end
	for model in pairs(outlineCandidates) do
		if not wanted[model] then clearCosmeticOutline(model) end
	end
	for model in pairs(wanted) do
		local outline = model:FindFirstChild("CartoonOutline")
		if not outline then
			outline = Instance.new("Highlight")
			outline.Name = "CartoonOutline"
			outline:SetAttribute("PCCosmeticManaged", true)
			outline.Adornee = model
			outline.Parent = model
		end
		if outline:IsA("Highlight") then
			outline.Enabled = true
			outline.Adornee = model
			outline.FillTransparency = model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineFillTransparency") or 1
			outline.FillColor = model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineFillColor") or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			outline.OutlineTransparency = model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineTransparency") or 0
			outline.OutlineColor = model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineColor") or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			outline.DepthMode = model:GetAttribute("PCOutlineDepthMode") == "AlwaysOnTop" and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
		end
	end
end

table.insert(outlineConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
	outlineClock += delta
	if outlineClock >= 0.25 then outlineClock = 0 updateCartoonOutlines() end
end))

local function releaseCartoonOutlines()
	for _, connection in ipairs(outlineConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	for model in pairs(outlineCandidates) do if model.Parent then clearCosmeticOutline(model) end end
	table.clear(outlineCandidates)
	table.clear(knownHighlights)
end


local states = {}
local connections = {}
local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true

local MAX_DISTANCE = 150
local MAX_VISIBLE = 24
local MAX_SIZE = 3
local effectColours = {
	P04 = Color3.fromRGB(251, 165, 222),
	P09 = Color3.fromRGB(151, 212, 255),
	P12 = Color3.fromRGB(139, 255, 214),
	P15 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 232),
	P18 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 164, 69),
	P19 = Color3.fromRGB(182, 190, 255),
	P20 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 115),
	P21 = Color3.fromRGB(143, 217, 255),
	P22 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 177, 82),
	P25 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 231, 160),
	P35 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 194, 87),
}
local hoveringPets = { P10 = true, P12 = true, P14 = true, P19 = true, P23 = true, P25 = true, P28 = true, P35 = true }

local function horizontal(vector)
	return Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z)
end

local function smoothAlpha(speed, delta)
	return 1 - math.exp(-speed * delta)
end

local function visibleBounds(model)
	local lower = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local upper = -lower
	local count = 0
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then
			count += 1
			for x = -1, 1, 2 do
				for y = -1, 1, 2 do
					for z = -1, 1, 2 do
						local corner = part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size * Vector3.new(x, y, z) * 0.5)
						lower = lower:Min(corner)
						upper = upper:Max(corner)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if count == 0 then return nil end
	return lower, upper
end

local function release(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then return end
	states[player] = nil
	for _, track in state.tracks do
		track:Stop(0)
		track:Destroy()
	end
	state.model:Destroy()
end

local function prepareParts(model)
	local parts = {}
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BaseScript") then
			object.Enabled = false
		elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.CanCollide = false
			object.CanTouch = false
			object.CanQuery = false
			object.Massless = true
			object.Anchored = false
			table.insert(parts, object)
		elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
			object.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
			object.AutoRotate = false
		end
	end
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart", true) or model.PrimaryPart or parts[1]
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	local anchoredComponents = {}
	local function anchorComponent(part)
		if anchoredComponents[part] then return end
		anchoredComponents[part] = true
		for _, connected in part:GetConnectedParts(true) do
			anchoredComponents[connected] = true
		end
		part.Anchored = true
	end
	anchorComponent(root)
	for _, part in parts do anchorComponent(part) end
	return root
end

local function loadAnimations(state)
	local model = state.model
	local controller = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController", true)
		or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid", true)
	if not controller then return end
	local animator = controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	for _, animation in model:GetDescendants() do
		local name = animation.Name:lower()
		if animation:IsA("Animation") and animation.AnimationId ~= "" and (name == "idle" or name == "walk") then
			if not animator then
				animator = Instance.new("Animator")
				animator.Parent = controller
			end
			local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
			if success then
				if states[state.player] ~= state then track:Destroy() return end
				track.Looped = true
				track.Priority = name == "walk" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement or Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
				if state.tracks[name] then state.tracks[name]:Destroy() end
				state.tracks[name] = track
				track:Play(0.2, name == "idle" and 1 or 0)
			end
		end
	end
	if states[state.player] ~= state then return end
	if state.tracks.idle then state.tracks.idle:AdjustWeight(state.walkMode and state.tracks.walk and 0 or 1, 0.2) end
	if state.tracks.walk then state.tracks.walk:AdjustWeight(state.walkMode and 1 or 0, 0.2) end
end

local function addSparkles(state, root, lower, upper)
	local colour = effectColours[state.id]
	if not colour then return end
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "PetSparkleOrigin"
	attachment.Position = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(
		(lower.X + upper.X) * 0.5, lower.Y + (upper.Y - lower.Y) * 0.7, (lower.Z + upper.Z) * 0.5
	))
	attachment.Parent = root
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = "PetSparkles"
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(colour)
	emitter.Rate = 1.5
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.8)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.45)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(160, 160)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.18),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.15),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
	emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-35, 35)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.35
	emitter.LightInfluence = 0.5
	emitter.Enabled = false
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	state.emitter = emitter
end

local function createState(player, id, character)
	local template = assets:FindFirstChild(id)
	if not template or not template:IsA("Model") then return end
	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = tostring(player.UserId) .. "_" .. id
	model:SetAttribute("PetOwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	local restRotation = model:GetPivot().Rotation
	model:PivotTo(restRotation)
	local lower, upper = visibleBounds(model)
	if not lower then model:Destroy() return end
	local size = upper - lower
	local largest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	if largest > MAX_SIZE then
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * MAX_SIZE / largest)
		lower, upper = visibleBounds(model)
	end
	model.Parent = visuals
	local root = prepareParts(model)
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end
	local state = {
		player = player, id = id, character = character, model = model, tracks = {},
		phase = (player.UserId % 97) * math.pi * 2 / 97,
		position = nil, ground = nil, groundClock = 1, movement = 0,
		facing = CFrame.identity, walkMode = false,
		restRotation = restRotation,
		centreOffset = CFrame.new(-(lower.X + upper.X) * 0.5, -lower.Y, -(lower.Z + upper.Z) * 0.5),
		facingOffset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(tonumber(template:GetAttribute("PetFacingYaw")) or 0), 0),
	}
	states[player] = state
	addSparkles(state, root, lower, upper)
	task.spawn(loadAnimations, state)
	return state
end

local function characterRoot(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		return root, humanoid, character
	end
	return nil
end

local function reconcile()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position
	local localRoot = characterRoot(localPlayer)
	if localRoot then origin = localRoot.Position end
	if not origin then return end
	local candidates = {}
	local exclusions = { visuals }
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then table.insert(exclusions, player.Character) end
		local id = player:GetAttribute("PCPet")
		local root, _, character = characterRoot(player)
		if type(id) == "string" and id:match("^P%d%d$") and root and player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") ~= true then
			local distance = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
			if distance < MAX_DISTANCE or player == localPlayer then
				table.insert(candidates, { player = player, id = id, character = character,
					distance = player == localPlayer and -1 or distance })
			end
		end
	end
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclusions
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
	local wanted = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(MAX_VISIBLE, #candidates) do
		local entry = candidates[index]
		wanted[entry.player] = true
		local state = states[entry.player]
		if state and (state.id ~= entry.id or state.character ~= entry.character or not state.model.Parent) then
			release(entry.player)
			state = nil
		end
		if not state then createState(entry.player, entry.id, entry.character) end
	end
	for player in states do
		if not wanted[player] then release(player) end
	end
end

local function updateState(state, delta, observer, reducedMotion, effectsEnabled)
	local root, humanoid, character = characterRoot(state.player)
	if not root or character ~= state.character or state.player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true then release(state.player) return end
	local side = state.player.UserId % 2 == 0 and 2.4 or -2.4
	local target = root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(side, 0, 3.4))
	local from = root.Position
	local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(from, horizontal(target - from), raycastParams)
	if obstruction then
		target = obstruction.Position + obstruction.Normal * 0.9
	end
	target = horizontal(target)
	local teleported = not state.position or (target - state.position).Magnitude > 35
	if teleported then
		state.position = target
		state.ground = nil
		state.groundClock = 1
	end
	local previous = state.position
	state.position = previous:Lerp(target, smoothAlpha(7.5, delta))
	local speed = (state.position - previous).Magnitude / math.max(delta, 0.001)
	state.movement += (math.clamp(speed / 9, 0, 1) - state.movement) * smoothAlpha(7, delta)
	local direction = horizontal(target - previous)
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.35 then direction = horizontal(root.CFrame.LookVector) end
	if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		local desiredFacing = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, direction.Unit)
		state.facing = teleported and desiredFacing or state.facing:Lerp(desiredFacing, smoothAlpha(9, delta))
	end
	state.groundClock += delta
	if state.groundClock >= 0.08 then
		state.groundClock = 0
		local rayOrigin = Vector3.new(state.position.X, root.Position.Y + 6, state.position.Z)
		local result = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, Vector3.new(0, -64, 0), raycastParams)
		local foot = character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot") or character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		local floor = foot and foot:IsA("BasePart") and foot.Position.Y - foot.Size.Y * 0.5 or root.Position.Y - 3
		state.groundTarget = result and result.Position.Y or floor
	end
	local groundTarget = state.groundTarget or root.Position.Y - 3
	state.ground = state.ground and state.ground + (groundTarget - state.ground) * smoothAlpha(18, delta) or groundTarget
	state.phase += delta * math.pi * 2 * (0.85 + state.movement * 1.75)
	local hover = hoveringPets[state.id]
	local hop = (1 - math.cos(state.phase)) * 0.5
	local bounce = hover and 0.35 + hop * 0.16 or hop * (0.06 + state.movement * 0.45)
	local roll = math.sin(state.phase * 0.5) * math.rad(1 + state.movement * 3)
	local pitch = math.sin(state.phase) * math.rad(state.movement * 3)
	if reducedMotion then bounce *= 0.2 roll = 0 pitch = 0 end
	local flightHeight = math.clamp(tonumber(state.model:GetAttribute("PCPetHoverHeight")) or 0, 0, 5)
	if flightHeight > 0 then
		bounce = math.sin(state.phase * 0.5) * (reducedMotion and 0.015 or 0.07)
		pitch, roll = 0, 0
	end
	local position = Vector3.new(state.position.X, state.ground + 0.12 + flightHeight + bounce, state.position.Z)
	state.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * state.facing * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, roll)
		* state.centreOffset * state.facingOffset * state.restRotation)
	local walking = state.movement > (state.walkMode and 0.12 or 0.25)
	if walking ~= state.walkMode then
		state.walkMode = walking
		if state.tracks.idle then state.tracks.idle:AdjustWeight(walking and state.tracks.walk and 0 or 1, 0.2) end

local function showCoinPickup(amount, position)
	if lobbyHudSuppressed() then return end
	if typeof(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 or amount % 1 ~= 0 or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local templates = gui:FindFirstChild("Templates")
	local template = templates and templates:FindFirstChild("CoinPickupPopup")
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Playground Lobby")
	local gameplay = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
	local markers = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("CoinSpawns")
	if not template or not template:IsA("BillboardGui") or not markers then return end
	local anchor, distance = nil, 8
	for _, marker in ipairs(markers:GetChildren()) do
		if marker:IsA("BasePart") then
			local gap = (marker.Position - position).Magnitude
			if gap < distance then anchor, distance = marker, gap end
		end
	end
	if not anchor then return end
	local popup = template:Clone()
	popup.Name = "CoinPickup"
	local label = popup:FindFirstChild("Amount")
	if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then popup:Destroy() return end
	label.Text = "+" .. tostring(amount)
	popup.Adornee = anchor
	popup.StudsOffsetWorldSpace += position - anchor.Position
	popup.Enabled = true
	popup.Parent = gui
	local lift = TweenService:Create(popup, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { StudsOffsetWorldSpace = popup.StudsOffsetWorldSpace + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0) })
	local fade = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 0.35), { TextTransparency = 1 })
	local record = { tweens = { lift, fade } }
	coinPopups[popup] = record
	local stroke = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if stroke then table.insert(record.tweens, TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 0.35), { Transparency = 1 })) end
	record.completed = fade.Completed:Connect(function() clearCoinPopup(popup) end)
	for _, tween in ipairs(record.tweens) do tween:Play() end
	return popup
end

local function itemThumbnail(item)

local function clearModelPreview(record)
	if record.previewModel then record.previewModel:Destroy() record.previewModel = nil end
	if record.previewCamera then record.previewCamera:Destroy() record.previewCamera = nil end
	record.card.Preview.CurrentCamera = nil
end

local function frameModelPreview(record)
	if not record.previewModel or not record.previewCamera then return end
	local viewport = record.card.Preview
	local bounds, size = record.previewModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local radius = math.max(0.1, size.Magnitude * 0.5)
	local aspect = math.max(0.1, viewport.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(1, viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y))
	local halfFov = math.rad(record.previewCamera.FieldOfView * 0.5)
	local limitingFov = math.min(halfFov, math.atan(math.tan(halfFov) * aspect))
	local distance = radius / math.sin(limitingFov) * 1.08
	local center = bounds.Position
	record.previewCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, -1).Unit * distance, center)
end

local function buildModelPreview(record, item)
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundCosmeticAssets")
	local template = assets and assets:FindFirstChild(item.id)
	if not template or not template:IsA("Model") then return false end
	local viewport = record.card.Preview
	local world = viewport:FindFirstChild("World")
	if not world then return false end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		world:ClearAllChildren()
		local model = template:Clone()
		record.previewModel = model
		model.Name = "ItemModel"
		for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BaseScript") or object:IsA("ObjectValue") or object:IsA("Highlight") then
				object:Destroy()
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
				object.Anchored = true
				object.CanCollide = false
				object.CanTouch = false
				object.CanQuery = false
			end
		end
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.identity)
		model.Parent = world
		local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
		camera.Name = "PreviewCamera"
		camera.FieldOfView = 35
		camera.Parent = viewport
		record.previewCamera = camera
		viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
		frameModelPreview(record)
	end)
	if not ok then clearModelPreview(record) end
	return ok
end

local function refreshThumbnail(record)
	if not alive or not record.card.Parent then return end
	local thumbnail = record.card.Thumbnail
	local status = record.card.ThumbnailStatus
	status.Visible = thumbnail.Visible and (thumbnail.Image == "" or not thumbnail.IsLoaded)
	status.Text = (thumbnail.Image == "" or record.thumbnailTimedOut) and "Preview unavailable" or "Loading preview..."
end

local function renderPreview(record, item)
	local id = item and item.id or nil
	local image = itemThumbnail(item)
	if record.previewId == id and record.card.Thumbnail.Image == image and (image ~= "" or record.previewModel or not item) then return end
	clearModelPreview(record)
	record.previewId = id
	record.previewToken = (record.previewToken or 0) + 1
	local token = record.previewToken
	record.thumbnailTimedOut = false
	local modelReady = item and image == "" and buildModelPreview(record, item) or false
	record.card.Preview.Visible = modelReady
	record.card.Thumbnail.Image = image
	record.card.Thumbnail.Visible = item ~= nil and not modelReady
	refreshThumbnail(record)
	if item and image ~= "" and not record.card.Thumbnail.IsLoaded then
		task.delay(8, function()
			if alive and record.previewToken == token and record.card.Parent and record.card.Thumbnail.Image == image then
				record.thumbnailTimedOut = true
				refreshThumbnail(record)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function requirement(item, unlock)
	local rule = item.unlock or { kind = "Coins", amount = item.price or 0 }
	if rule.kind == "Starter" then return "Starter reward", "FREE" end
	if rule.kind == "VIP" then return "Included with VIP", "VIP EXCLUSIVE" end
	if rule.kind == "BetaTester" then return "Beta Tester reward", "BETA TESTER" end
	if rule.kind == "Coins" then return tostring(item.price or rule.amount or 0) .. " coins", item.category end
	local progress = unlock and unlock.progress or 0
	local target = rule.amount or 0
	if rule.kind == "Level" then return "Level " .. tostring(target), tostring(math.min(progress, target)) .. " / " .. tostring(target) end
	return tostring(target) .. " " .. (gameLabels[rule.gameId] or "total") .. " wins", tostring(math.min(progress, target)) .. " / " .. tostring(target)
end

local function isEquipped(item)
	if item.slot == "Gear" and typeof(data.equipped.Toys) == "table" then
		return table.find(data.equipped.Toys, item.id) ~= nil
	end
	return data.equipped[item.slot] == item.id
end

local function refreshCards()
	refreshWallet()
	local commerce = category == "BuyCoins"
	shop.Cards.Visible = not commerce
	shop.BuyCoinsPanel.Visible = commerce
	shop.Status.Visible = not commerce
	shop:SetAttribute("SelectedCategory", category)
	local filtered = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
		if category == "All" or item.category == category then table.insert(filtered, item) end
	end
	emoteEmptyState.Visible = category == "Emotes" and #filtered == 0
	pager.Visible = not commerce and #filtered > 0
	pageCount = math.max(1, math.ceil(#filtered / math.max(1, #slots)))
	page = math.clamp(page, 1, pageCount)
	setText(pager.PageLabel, tostring(page) .. " / " .. tostring(pageCount))
	for _, spec in ipairs({ { pager.Previous, page > 1 }, { pager.Next, page < pageCount } }) do
		spec[1].Active = spec[2] and not busy
		spec[1].Selectable = spec[1].Active
		spec[1].BackgroundColor3 = spec[1].Active and blue or muted
	end
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local item = filtered[(page - 1) * #slots + index]
		local card = record.card
		record.item = item
		card.Visible = item ~= nil
		renderPreview(record, item)
		if item then
			card:SetAttribute("CatalogId", item.id)
			setText(card:FindFirstChild("Name"), item.name)
			local owned = data.owned[item.id] == true
			local equipped = isEquipped(item)
			local unlock = data.unlocks[item.id]
			local price, detail = requirement(item, unlock)
			setText(card.Price, owned and (equipped and "Equipped" or "Owned") or price)
			setText(card.Category, owned and item.category or detail)
			local isCoins = item.unlock and item.unlock.kind == "Coins"
			local canBuy = isCoins and (unlock and unlock.purchasable == true or not unlock and data.coins >= (item.price or 0))
			local available = item.available ~= false and (item.slot ~= "Emote" or emotePlayable(item))
			local action = not available and "UNAVAILABLE" or not data.ready and "LOADING" or equipped and "UNEQUIP" or owned and "EQUIP" or isCoins and "BUY" or item.unlock and item.unlock.kind == "VIP" and "VIP ONLY" or item.unlock and item.unlock.kind == "BetaTester" and "BETA ONLY" or "LOCKED"
			if busy then action = "PLEASE WAIT" end
			setText(card.Action, action)
			card.Action.Visible = true
			card.Action.Active = not busy and data.ready and available and (owned or canBuy)
			card.Action.Selectable = card.Action.Active
			card.Action.BackgroundColor3 = not card.Action.Active and muted or equipped and mint or owned and blue or gold
			local canPlay = emotePlayable(item) and owned
			setText(card.Try, canPlay and "PLAY" or "INFO")
			card.Try.Visible = true
			card.Try.Active = not canPlay or not busy and data.ready and emoteInLobby()
			card.Try.Selectable = card.Try.Active
			local outline = card:FindFirstChild("Outline")
			if outline then outline.Color = equipped and gold or ink end
		else
			card:SetAttribute("CatalogId", nil)
		end
	end
	for _, button in ipairs(shop.Categories:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") and button.Visible then button.BackgroundColor3 = button.Name == category and gold or white end
	end
end

local function applyReply(reply)
	if typeof(reply) ~= "table" then return end
	if typeof(reply.coins) == "number" then data.coins = reply.coins end
	if typeof(reply.ready) == "boolean" then data.ready = reply.ready end
	if typeof(reply.owned) == "table" then data.owned = reply.owned end
	if typeof(reply.equipped) == "table" then data.equipped = reply.equipped end
	if typeof(reply.unlocks) == "table" then data.unlocks = reply.unlocks end
	if typeof(reply.unlockSerial) == "number" and reply.unlockSerial ~= lastUnlockSerial then
		lastUnlockSerial = reply.unlockSerial
		if typeof(reply.newlyUnlocked) == "table" and #reply.newlyUnlocked > 0 then
			local names = {}
			for index, id in ipairs(reply.newlyUnlocked) do
				if index > 2 then break end
				local item = catalog.ById[id]
				if item then table.insert(names, item.name) end
			end
			if #names > 0 then
				local more = #reply.newlyUnlocked > 2 and " and " .. tostring(#reply.newlyUnlocked - 2) .. " more" or ""
				showToast("Unlocked: " .. table.concat(names, ", ") .. more .. "!", 5)
			end
		end
	end
	refreshCards()
end

local request
request = function(action, id, quiet, onSuccess)
	if busy then
		if action == "GetStatus" then pendingStatus = true end
		return
	end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShopRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
		if not quiet then shop.Status.Text = "The shop is getting ready. Try again in a moment." end
		return
	end
	busy = true
	refreshCards()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, id) end)
		busy = false
		if ok and typeof(reply) == "table" then
			applyReply(reply)
			if reply.ok == true and onSuccess then onSuccess(reply) end
			if not quiet or not reply.ok then shop.Status.Text = tostring(reply.message or (reply.ok and "All set!" or "Try again in a moment.")) end
			if not reply.ok and not shop.Visible and not quiet then showToast(reply.message or "Try again in a moment.") end
		else
			refreshCards()
			if not quiet then shop.Status.Text = "That did not go through. Try again in a moment." end
		end
		if pendingStatus then
			pendingStatus = false
			task.defer(function() request("GetStatus", nil, true) end)
		end
	end)
end

			setShop(false)
			showToast("Starting " .. item.name .. ". Move to stop.", 3)
		end)

	end
	local unlock = data.unlocks[item.id]
	local description = item.description or item.name
	if unlock and not data.owned[item.id] then description ..= " " .. unlock.label .. "." end
	showToast(description, 5)

local function progress(gradient,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 if fraction<=0 then gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(1)
 elseif fraction>=1 then gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0)
 else
  gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.max(0.0001,fraction-0.0001),0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.min(0.9999,fraction+0.0001),1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
 end
end

end

local function sanitize(object)
 for _,descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
  local keep=descendant:IsA("BasePart") or descendant:IsA("DataModelMesh") or descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture")
   or descendant:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or descendant:IsA("Attachment") or descendant:IsA("Bone")
  if not keep then descendant:Destroy() end
 end
 local parts={}
 if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts,object) end
 for _,descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts,descendant) end end
 for _,part in ipairs(parts) do part.Anchored=true part.CanCollide=false part.CanTouch=false part.CanQuery=false part.CastShadow=false end
 return parts
end

local function clonePart(source)

local function rebuildPreview()
 if not alive then return end
 local character=player.Character
 local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
 if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 local generation=previewGeneration
 local headAttachments={}
 for _,attachment in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do if attachment:IsA("Attachment") then headAttachments[attachment.Name]=true end end
 local prototype=Instance.new("Model")
 prototype.Name="AvatarPreview"
 local headClone=clonePart(head)
 if not headClone then prototype:Destroy() return end
 local headOrigin=head.CFrame
 local headParts=sanitize(headClone)
 for _,part in ipairs(headParts) do part.CFrame=headOrigin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) end
 headClone.Parent=prototype
 prototype.PrimaryPart=headClone
 for _,accessory in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
  if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
   local handle=accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
   if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
    local attachedToHead=false
    for _,attachment in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
     if attachment:IsA("Attachment") and headAttachments[attachment.Name] then attachedToHead=true break end
     if attachment:IsA("Weld") and (attachment.Part0==head or attachment.Part1==head) then attachedToHead=true break end
    end
    if attachedToHead then
     local clone=clonePart(handle)
     if clone then
      clone.Name=accessory.Name
      local parts=sanitize(clone)
      for _,part in ipairs(parts) do part.CFrame=headOrigin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) end
      clone.Parent=prototype
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if not alive or generation~=previewGeneration or character~=player.Character then prototype:Destroy() return end
 for _,target in ipairs(panels) do
  local viewport=target.FacePreview
  local world=viewport.World
  local clone=prototype:Clone()
  if clone then
   local old=world:FindFirstChild("AvatarPreview")
   if old then old:Destroy() end
   clone.Parent=world
   viewport.CurrentCamera=viewport.Camera
  end
 end
 prototype:Destroy()
end

 for name, offer in pairs(offers) do
  local card = offer.card
  local entry = config:FindFirstChild(name)

  local ready = config:GetAttribute("Ready") == true and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true
  local valid = configured and offer.id == entry.Value and offer.price ~= nil
  local isOwned, isIncluded = owned(name), included(name)
  local canBuy = ready and valid and not isOwned and not isIncluded and pending == nil and not inRound()
  card.Buy.Active = canBuy
  card.Buy.Selectable = canBuy
  card.Buy.AutoButtonColor = canBuy
  caption(card.Buy, isOwned and "OWNED" or isIncluded and "IN VIP" or tostring(offer.price or entry and entry:GetAttribute("Robux") or offer.plannedPrice) .. " ROBUX")

  card.Buy.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = canBuy and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(190, 196, 208)

local function loadOffers()
 if loading then reloadQueued = true return end
 loading = true
 local available = 0
 for name, offer in pairs(offers) do
  local entry = config:FindFirstChild(name)
  local id = entry and entry:IsA("IntValue") and entry.Value or 0
  offer.id, offer.price = id, nil
  offer.kind = entry and entry:GetAttribute("Kind")
  if id > 0 then
   local infoType = offer.kind == "GamePass" and Enum.InfoType.GamePass or Enum.InfoType.Product
   local ok, info = pcall(function() return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(id, infoType) end)
   if not alive then return end
   if entry.Value == id and ok and typeof(info) == "table" and info.IsForSale ~= false and typeof(info.PriceInRobux) == "number" and info.PriceInRobux >= 1 then
    offer.price = info.PriceInRobux
    available += 1
   end
  end
 end
 loading = false
 refresh()
 if not pending then
  panel.Status.Text = available > 0 and "Roblox confirms the price before you buy." or "Purchases are coming soon."
 end
 if reloadQueued then reloadQueued = false task.defer(loadOffers) end
end

 pending = { id = offer.id, kind = offer.kind }
 panel.Status.Text = "Confirm your purchase in the Roblox window."

  if offer.kind == "GamePass" then MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, offer.id)

 end)

  pending = nil
  panel.Status.Text = "Roblox couldn't open the purchase. Please try again."
  refresh()
 end
end
