local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = script.Parent
gui.Enabled = false
for _, name in ipairs({ "Toggle", "AdminHub", "Panel", "CompactPanel", "CompactToggle" }) do
	local object = gui:FindFirstChild(name)
	if object then object.Visible = false end
end
local hub = gui:WaitForChild("AdminHub")
local pages = hub.Pages
local itemsPage = pages.Items
local catalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundCatalog"))
local connections = {}
local busy = false
local opened = false
local tab = "Items"
local category = "All"
local page = 1
local pageCount = 1
local selectedUserId = player.UserId
local targetData = nil
local roster = {}
local slots = {}
local states = {}
local gameControls = {}
local limits = { coinsPerGrant = 1000000, levelsPerGrant = 100, maxLevel = 1000 }
local gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 78)
local blue = Color3.fromRGB(89, 193, 244)
local muted = Color3.fromRGB(194, 201, 206)
local green = Color3.fromRGB(130, 225, 180)
local mudActions = { MudStart = true, MudShooter = true, MudMedic = true }
local phases = { Waiting = "Ready", Countdown = "Countdown", Crossing = "Playing", Playing = "Playing", Hiding = "Hide now", Seeking = "Seekers released", Results = "Round finished", Intermission = "Next round" }
local gameNames = { BritishBulldog = "Bulldog", TagYoureIt = "Tag", StuckInTheMud = "Mud", HideAndSeek = "Hide and Seek", All = "total" }
local request

local function connect(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end
for _, fallback in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
	if fallback.Name == "ArtFallback" and fallback:IsA("Frame") then
		local skin = fallback.Parent:FindFirstChild("ReusableSkin")
		if skin and skin:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			local function updateFallback() fallback.Visible = not skin.IsLoaded end
			connect(skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"), updateFallback)
			connect(skin:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"), updateFallback)
			updateFallback()
		end
	end
end
local function admin()
	return player:GetAttribute("PlaygroundAdmin") == true
end
local function caption(object, text)
	object.Text = text
	local live = object:FindFirstChild("LiveCaption")
	if live then live.Text = text end
end
local function enabled(button, value, color)
	button.Active = value
	button.Selectable = value
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.BackgroundColor3 = value and (color or button:GetAttribute("ReadyColor") or blue) or muted
end
local function message(text)
	hub.Message.Text = tostring(text or "")
end
local function syncVisibility()
	local allowed = admin()
	gui.Enabled = allowed
	if not allowed then opened = false end
	hub.Visible = allowed and opened
	gui.Panel.Visible = false
	gui.CompactPanel.Visible = false
	gui.CompactToggle.Visible = false
	gui.Toggle.Visible = allowed
	caption(gui.Toggle, opened and "CLOSE" or "ADMIN")
	for _, pageObject in ipairs(pages:GetChildren()) do
		if pageObject:IsA("GuiObject") then pageObject.Visible = pageObject.Name == tab end
	end
	for _, button in ipairs(hub.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then enabled(button, allowed, button.Name == tab and gold or blue) end
	end
end
local function sortedRoster(source)
	local result = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(source) do
		if typeof(entry.userId) == "number" and typeof(entry.name) == "string" then table.insert(result, entry) end
	end
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		if a.userId == player.UserId then return b.userId ~= player.UserId end
		if b.userId == player.UserId then return false end
		return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name)
	end)
	return result
end
local function refreshLocalRoster()
	local list = {}
	for _, current in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(list, { userId = current.UserId, name = current.Name, displayName = current.DisplayName, ready = current:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true })
	end
	roster = sortedRoster(list)
end
local function selectedEntry()
	for index, entry in ipairs(roster) do if entry.userId == selectedUserId then return entry, index end end
	return nil, nil
end
local function rewardReady()
	return admin() and not busy and targetData ~= nil and targetData.ready == true
end
local function syncTarget()
	local entry = selectedEntry()
	local own = selectedUserId == player.UserId
	local name = entry and ((entry.displayName or entry.name) .. " (@" .. entry.name .. ")") or "Player unavailable"
	hub.Target.PlayerName.Text = (own and "SELF · " or "") .. name
	hub.Target.PlayerStats.Text = targetData and targetData.ready and (tostring(targetData.coins or 0) .. " coins · Level " .. tostring(targetData.level or 1)) or "Profile loading..."
	enabled(hub.Target.Previous, admin() and not busy and #roster > 1)
	enabled(hub.Target.Next, admin() and not busy and #roster > 1)
	enabled(hub.Target.Self, admin() and not busy, own and gold or blue)
	enabled(pages.Rewards.Coins.GrantCoins, rewardReady())
	enabled(pages.Rewards.Levels.AddLevels, rewardReady())
	local entitlements = targetData and targetData.entitlements or {}
	for _, kind in ipairs({ "VIP", "BetaTester" }) do
		local button = pages.Rewards.Entitlements["Grant" .. kind]
		local granted = entitlements[kind] == true
		local label = kind == "VIP" and "VIP" or "BETA TESTER"
		caption(button, busy and "WAIT..." or granted and (label .. " ACTIVE") or ("GRANT " .. label))
		enabled(button, rewardReady() and not granted, kind == "VIP" and gold or green)
	end
end
local function unlockText(item)
	local unlock = item.unlock
	if not unlock or unlock.kind == "Starter" then return "Starter reward" end
	if unlock.kind == "Coins" then return tostring(item.price) .. " coins" end
	if unlock.kind == "Level" then return "Level " .. tostring(unlock.amount) end
	if unlock.kind == "VIP" then return "VIP reward" end
	if unlock.kind == "BetaTester" then return "Beta Tester reward" end
	return tostring(unlock.amount) .. " " .. (gameNames[unlock.gameId] or "total") .. " wins"
end
local function syncItems()
	local query = string.lower(string.sub(itemsPage.Search.Value.Text, 1, 100))
	local matches = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
		if (category == "All" or item.category == category) and (query == "" or string.find(string.lower(item.id .. " " .. item.name), query, 1, true)) then table.insert(matches, item) end
	end
	pageCount = math.max(1, math.ceil(#matches / #slots))
	page = math.clamp(page, 1, pageCount)
	itemsPage.Empty.Visible = #matches == 0
	itemsPage.Pager.PageLabel.Text = tostring(page) .. " / " .. tostring(pageCount)
	enabled(itemsPage.Pager.Previous, page > 1 and not busy)
	enabled(itemsPage.Pager.Next, page < pageCount and not busy)
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local item = matches[(page - 1) * #slots + index]
		record.item = item
		record.row.Visible = item ~= nil
		if item then
			record.row:SetAttribute("CatalogId", item.id)
			local owned = targetData and targetData.owned and targetData.owned[item.id] == true
			local equipped = targetData and targetData.equipped and targetData.equipped[item.slot] == item.id
			record.row.ItemName.Text = item.id .. " · " .. item.name
			record.row.Detail.Text = item.category .. " · " .. (equipped and "Equipped" or owned and "Owned" or unlockText(item))
			caption(record.row.Grant, busy and "WAIT..." or owned and "OWNED" or "GRANT")
			caption(record.row.GrantEquip, busy and "WAIT..." or equipped and "EQUIPPED" or owned and "EQUIP" or "GRANT + EQUIP")
			enabled(record.row.Grant, rewardReady() and not owned and item.available ~= false)
			enabled(record.row.GrantEquip, rewardReady() and not equipped and item.available ~= false, green)
		end
	end
	for _, id in ipairs({ "All", "Bats", "Pets", "Toys" }) do enabled(itemsPage.Filters[id], admin(), id == category and gold or blue) end
end
local function syncRounds()
	local mud = states.MudState
	for action, button in pairs(gameControls) do
		local allowed = admin() and not busy and (not mudActions[action] or mud and mud:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") == true)
		enabled(button, allowed)
	end
	for id, stateName in pairs({ BritishBulldog = "BritishBulldogState", TagYoureIt = "TagState", StuckInTheMud = "MudState", HideAndSeek = "HideAndSeekState" }) do
		local state = states[stateName]
		local phase = state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") or "Waiting"
		local mode = state and state:GetAttribute("Mode") or ""
		local text = (string.find(mode, "Practice", 1, true) and "Solo practice · " or "") .. (phases[phase] or phase)
		if id == "StuckInTheMud" and (not mud or mud:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") ~= true) then text = "Gun access pending" end
		pages.Rounds[id].Status.Text = text
	end
	local state = states.PlaygroundState
	caption(gameControls.ToggleAutomatic, state and state:GetAttribute("AutomaticRounds") == true and "AUTO ROUNDS: ON" or "AUTO ROUNDS: OFF")
end
local function sync()
	syncVisibility()
	syncTarget()
	syncItems()
	syncRounds()
end
local function applyReply(reply, requestedTarget)
	if typeof(reply.players) == "table" then roster = sortedRoster(reply.players) end
	if typeof(reply.limits) == "table" then
		for key in pairs(limits) do if typeof(reply.limits[key]) == "number" then limits[key] = reply.limits[key] end end
	end
	if requestedTarget == selectedUserId and typeof(reply.target) == "table" and reply.target.userId == selectedUserId then targetData = reply.target end
end
request = function(action, payload, quiet)
	if not admin() or busy then return end
	if mudActions[action] and (not states.MudState or states.MudState:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") ~= true) then return end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundAdminRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then message("Admin controls are getting ready.") return end
	local requestedTarget = selectedUserId
	payload = payload or {}
	payload.targetUserId = requestedTarget
	busy = true
	sync()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, payload) end)
		busy = false
		if not gui.Parent then return end
		if ok and typeof(reply) == "table" then
			applyReply(reply, requestedTarget)
			if not quiet or not reply.ok then message(reply.message or (reply.ok and "Done." or "Request did not complete.")) end
		else message("Server unavailable. Try again.") end
		sync()
		if requestedTarget ~= selectedUserId and admin() then task.defer(function() request("GetStatus", nil, true) end) end
	end)
end
local function selectTarget(userId)
	if busy then return end
	selectedUserId = userId
	targetData = nil
	message("Rewards will go to the selected player.")
	sync()
	request("GetStatus", nil, true)
end
local function cycleTarget(direction)
	if busy or #roster == 0 then return end
	local _, index = selectedEntry()
	selectTarget(roster[((index or 1) - 1 + direction) % #roster + 1].userId)
end
for _, row in ipairs(itemsPage.Rows:GetChildren()) do
	if row:IsA("Frame") and row:FindFirstChild("Grant") then table.insert(slots, { row = row }) end
end
table.sort(slots, function(a, b) return a.row.Name < b.row.Name end)
for _, record in ipairs(slots) do
	connect(record.row.Grant.Activated, function()
		if record.item and record.row.Grant.Active then request("GrantItem", { itemId = record.item.id, equip = false }) end
	end)
	connect(record.row.GrantEquip.Activated, function()
		if record.item and record.row.GrantEquip.Active then request("GrantItem", { itemId = record.item.id, equip = true }) end
	end)
end
for _, id in ipairs({ "All", "Bats", "Pets", "Toys" }) do
	connect(itemsPage.Filters[id].Activated, function() category = id page = 1 itemsPage.Rows.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero syncItems() end)
end
connect(itemsPage.Search.Value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function() page = 1 itemsPage.Rows.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero syncItems() end)
for _, spec in ipairs({ { "Previous", -1 }, { "Next", 1 } }) do
	connect(itemsPage.Pager[spec[1]].Activated, function()
		if busy then return end
		page = math.clamp(page + spec[2], 1, pageCount)
		itemsPage.Rows.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
		syncItems()
	end)
end
local function grantAmount(action, box, maximum)
	if not rewardReady() then return end
	local amount = tonumber(box.Text)
	if not amount or amount ~= amount or amount % 1 ~= 0 or amount < 1 or amount > maximum then
		message("Enter a whole number from 1 to " .. tostring(maximum) .. ".")
		return
	end
	request(action, { amount = amount })
end
connect(pages.Rewards.Coins.GrantCoins.Activated, function() grantAmount("GrantCoins", pages.Rewards.Coins.Amount.Value, limits.coinsPerGrant) end)
connect(pages.Rewards.Levels.AddLevels.Activated, function() grantAmount("AddLevels", pages.Rewards.Levels.Amount.Value, limits.levelsPerGrant) end)
for _, kind in ipairs({ "VIP", "BetaTester" }) do
	local button = pages.Rewards.Entitlements["Grant" .. kind]
	connect(button.Activated, function()
		if button.Active and rewardReady() then request("Grant" .. kind) end
	end)
end
connect(hub.Target.Previous.Activated, function() cycleTarget(-1) end)
connect(hub.Target.Next.Activated, function() cycleTarget(1) end)
connect(hub.Target.Self.Activated, function() selectTarget(player.UserId) end)
for _, button in ipairs(hub.Tabs:GetChildren()) do
	if button:IsA("TextButton") then connect(button.Activated, function() tab = button.Name syncVisibility() end) end
end
for _, name in ipairs({ "BBStart", "BBRunner", "BBBulldog", "TagStart", "TagRunner", "TagTagger", "MudStart", "MudShooter", "MudMedic", "HSStart", "StopRound", "ToggleAutomatic" }) do
	local control = pages.Rounds:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	gameControls[name] = control
	connect(control.Activated, function() if control.Active then request(name) end end)
end
local function toggle()
	if not admin() then return end
	opened = not opened
	syncVisibility()
	if opened then refreshLocalRoster() request("GetStatus", nil, true) end
end
connect(gui.Toggle.Activated, toggle)
connect(hub.Close.Activated, function() opened = false syncVisibility() end)
connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
	if not processed and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then toggle() end
end)
connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlaygroundAdmin"), sync)
connect(Players.PlayerAdded, function() refreshLocalRoster() syncTarget() end)
connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, function(leaving)
	for index = #roster, 1, -1 do if roster[index].userId == leaving.UserId then table.remove(roster, index) end end
	if leaving.UserId == selectedUserId then selectedUserId = player.UserId targetData = nil message("Player left. Rewards now target you.") end
	sync()
	if opened and not busy then request("GetStatus", nil, true) end
end)
local function bindState(object)
	if not ({ PlaygroundState = true, BritishBulldogState = true, TagState = true, MudState = true, HideAndSeekState = true })[object.Name] or states[object.Name] == object then return end
	states[object.Name] = object
	connect(object.AttributeChanged, syncRounds)
	syncRounds()
end
for _, name in ipairs({ "PlaygroundState", "BritishBulldogState", "TagState", "MudState", "HideAndSeekState" }) do
	local object = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if object then bindState(object) end
end
connect(ReplicatedStorage.ChildAdded, bindState)
connect(script.Destroying, function() for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end end)
refreshLocalRoster()
sync()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = script.Parent
local bar = gui:WaitForChild("Bar")
local catalogObject = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundCatalog", 10)
if not catalogObject then bar.Visible = false return end
local catalog = require(catalogObject)
local connections = {}
local slots = {}
local alive = true
local pending = false
local requestToken = 0
local notice = ""
local noticeUntil = 0
local activeIndex = 0
local activeId = ""
local refresh
local backpackSuppressed = false
local savedBackpackState = nil

local function showNativeBackpack(show)
	if not show and not backpackSuppressed then
		local ok, previous = pcall(function() return StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack) end)
		if not ok then return end
		local applied = pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end)
		if applied then savedBackpackState = previous backpackSuppressed = true end
	elseif show and backpackSuppressed then
		local applied = pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, savedBackpackState) end)
		if applied then backpackSuppressed = false savedBackpackState = nil end
	end
end

local function connect(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end

local function inRound()
	return player:GetAttribute("PCToyRoundPreparing") == true or player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true )
end

local function modalOpen()
	local shell = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShell")
	if shell then
		for _, name in ipairs({ "ShopPanel", "VotePanel", "CompactVotePanel" }) do
			local panel = shell:FindFirstChild(name)
			if panel and panel.Visible then return true end
		end
	end
	local wheel = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundEmoteWheel")
	local wheelPanel = wheel and wheel:FindFirstChild("Panel")
	if wheel and wheel.Enabled and wheelPanel and wheelPanel.Visible then return true end
	local admin = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundAdminPanel")
	local adminHub = admin and admin:FindFirstChild("AdminHub")
	if admin and admin.Enabled and adminHub and adminHub.Visible then return true end
	return GuiService.MenuIsOpen
end

local function sessionControlsBusy()
	local controls = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	return controls and (controls:GetAttribute("Spectating") == true or controls:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true or controls:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true)
end

local function usable()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true and not inRound() and not sessionControlsBusy() and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function tell(message, seconds)
	notice = tostring(message or "")
	noticeUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + (seconds or 3)
end

local function cooldownEndsAt(id)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local ember = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("PCToyEmberUntil")) or 0
	local attribute = id == "M07" and ember > now and "PCToyEmberShotUntil" or "PCToyCooldown_" .. id
	return tonumber(player:GetAttribute(attribute)) or 0
end

local function refreshThumbnail(record)
	if not alive or not record.button.Parent then return end
	local thumbnail = record.button.Thumbnail
	local note = record.button.PreviewNote
	note.Visible = thumbnail.Visible and (thumbnail.Image == "" or not thumbnail.IsLoaded)
	note.Text = (thumbnail.Image == "" or record.thumbnailTimedOut) and "NO PREVIEW" or "LOADING..."
end

local function preview(record, id)
	local item = catalog.ById[id]
	local image = item and typeof(item.thumbnail) == "string" and item.thumbnail or ""
	if record.id == id and record.button.Thumbnail.Image == image then return end
	record.id = id
	record.generation += 1
	local generation = record.generation
	record.thumbnailTimedOut = false
	record.button.Preview.Visible = false
	record.button.Thumbnail.Image = image
	record.button.Thumbnail.Visible = id ~= ""
	refreshThumbnail(record)
	if id ~= "" and image ~= "" and not record.button.Thumbnail.IsLoaded then
		task.delay(8, function()
			if alive and generation == record.generation and record.button.Parent and record.button.Thumbnail.Image == image then
				record.thumbnailTimedOut = true
				refreshThumbnail(record)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function syncLoadout()
	if not alive then return end
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local id = player:GetAttribute("PCToySlot" .. tostring(index))
		if typeof(id) ~= "string" or not catalog.ById[id] then id = "" end
		preview(record, id)
		record.button.ItemName.Text = id ~= "" and catalog.ById[id].name or "EMPTY"
	end
	activeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(player:GetAttribute("PCToyIndex")) or 0), 0, 4)
	activeId = slots[activeIndex] and slots[activeIndex].id or ""
	refresh()
end

local function invoke(remoteName, action, payload, itemId)
	if pending or not alive then return end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(remoteName)
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then tell("Toys are getting ready.") refresh() return end
	pending = true
	requestToken += 1
	local token = requestToken
	refresh()
	task.delay(8, function()
		if not alive or requestToken ~= token or not pending then return end
		requestToken += 1
		pending = false
		tell("That took too long. Try again.")
		refresh()
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, payload) end)
		if not alive or requestToken ~= token then return end
		pending = false
		if ok and typeof(reply) == "table" then
			if reply.message then tell(reply.message) elseif not reply.ok then tell("That did not go through.") end
		else
			tell("That did not go through. Try again.")
		end
		refresh()
	end)
end

local function aimAt(screenPosition)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return nil end
	local position = screenPosition or camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
	local ray = screenPosition and camera:ScreenPointToRay(position.X, position.Y) or camera:ViewportPointToRay(position.X, position.Y)
	local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = player.Character and { player.Character } or {}
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 500, parameters)
	return hit and hit.Position or ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 150
end

local function useToy(position)
	if not gui.Enabled or not bar.Visible or not usable() or modalOpen() or activeId == "" or pending then return end
	local item = catalog.ById[activeId]
	if item and item.toyActionPending then tell("This toy's action is coming soon.") refresh() return end
	if cooldownEndsAt(activeId) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return end
	invoke("PlaygroundToyRequest", "Use", aimAt(position), activeId)
end

local function selectToy(index)
	local record = slots[index]
	if not gui.Enabled or not record or record.id == "" or not bar.Visible or not usable() or modalOpen() or pending then return end
	invoke("PlaygroundShopRequest", "SelectToy", index)
end

refresh = function()
	if not alive then return end
	local hasToy = false
	for _, record in ipairs(slots) do if record.id ~= "" then hasToy = true break end end
	local available = usable()
	bar.Visible = hasToy and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true and not inRound() and not sessionControlsBusy() and not modalOpen()
	showNativeBackpack(not (hasToy and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true and not inRound() and gui.Enabled))
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local remaining = math.max(0, cooldownEndsAt(activeId) - now)
	local item = catalog.ById[activeId]
	local actionPending = item and item.toyActionPending == true
	local character = player.Character
	local heldTool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local heldId = heldTool and heldTool:GetAttribute("CatalogId")
	for index, record in ipairs(slots) do
		local selected = index == activeIndex and record.id ~= ""
		local selectionTag = record.button:FindFirstChild("Selected")
		selectionTag.Visible = selected
		selectionTag.Text = selected and heldId == record.id and "HELD" or "READY"
		record.button.Key.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 74) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 224)
		record.button.Active = available and not pending and record.id ~= ""
		record.button.Selectable = record.button.Active
		record.button.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = record.id == "" and Color3.fromRGB(155, 155, 155) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	bar.Use.Active = available and not pending and activeId ~= "" and remaining <= 0 and not actionPending
	bar.Use.Selectable = bar.Use.Active
	local label = pending and "WAIT..." or actionPending and "SOON" or remaining > 0 and string.format("%.1fs", remaining) or "USE"
	bar.Use.Text = label
	bar.Use.LiveCaption.Text = label
	bar.Use.ReusableSkin.ImageColor3 = bar.Use.Active and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 165)

local function acceptStatus(reply)

	if typeof(reply.owned) == "table" and typeof(reply.equipped) == "table" and typeof(reply.ready) == "boolean" then
		owned, equipped, ready = reply.owned, reply.equipped, reply.ready
		return true
	end
	return false
end

request = function(action, id)
	if not alive then return end
	if busy then
		if action == "GetStatus" then refreshQueued = true end
		return
	end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShopRequest")
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then tell("The emote shop is getting ready.") render() return end
	if action == "GetStatus" and os.clock() - lastFetch < 0.2 then
		refreshQueued = true
		return
	end
	busy = true
	requestSerial += 1
	local serial = requestSerial
	if action == "GetStatus" then lastFetch = os.clock() end
	render()
	task.delay(8, function()
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial or not busy then return end
		requestSerial += 1
		busy = false
		if requestWorker then pcall(task.cancel, requestWorker) requestWorker = nil end
		tell("That took too long. Open the wheel to try again.")
		render()
	end)
	requestWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, reply = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, id) end)
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial then return end
		requestWorker = nil
		busy = false
		local valid = ok and acceptStatus(reply)
		if not valid then
			tell("The emote shop could not respond. Try again.")
		elseif action == "UseEmote" and reply.ok == true then
			notice = ""
			setOpen(false)
		elseif action ~= "GetStatus" then
			tell(reply.message ~= "" and reply.message or (reply.ok and "Done." or "Try again in a moment."))
		end
		render()
		if panel.Visible then selectFirst() end
	end)
end

end

local function inputAction(_, state, input)
	if not gui.Enabled or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or GuiService.MenuIsOpen then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown and panel.Visible then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.Period or key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown then
		if inRound() or otherModalOpen() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then setOpen(not panel.Visible) end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	if not panel.Visible then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then setOpen(false)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then movePage(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then movePage(1)
		else
			local index = table.find(numberKeys, key)
			if index then playSlot(index) end
		end
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

local function targetsFor(gameId)
	local result = {}
	local attribute = roundAttributes[gameId]
	if not attribute then return result end
	for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = candidate.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if candidate ~= player and candidate:GetAttribute(attribute) == true and (not humanoid or humanoid.Health > 0)
			and (rejectedUntil[candidate.UserId] or 0) <= os.clock() then
			table.insert(result, candidate)

	end
	table.sort(result, function(a, b) return a.UserId < b.UserId end)
	return result

	ContextActionService:UnbindAction(movementAction)
	restoreMovement()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if camera then
		local subject = humanoid or (savedCamera and savedCamera.subject and savedCamera.subject.Parent and savedCamera.subject)
		camera.CameraSubject = subject
		camera.CameraType = inRound() and Enum.CameraType.Custom or (savedCamera and savedCamera.kind or Enum.CameraType.Custom)
		if savedCamera and not inRound() then
			camera.CFrame = savedCamera.cframe
			camera.Focus = savedCamera.focus
		end
	end
	savedCamera = nil
	local selected = GuiService.SelectedObject
	if selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = savedSelection and savedSelection.Parent and savedSelection or nil
	end
	savedSelection = nil
	panel.Visible = false
	if message then tell(message) end
end

local function applyTargetCamera(candidate)
	local humanoid = candidate and candidate.Character and candidate.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = candidate and candidate.Character and candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	target = candidate
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
	gui:SetAttribute("SpectatingUserId", candidate.UserId)
	panel.PlayerName.Text = candidate.DisplayName
	panel.Username.Text = "@" .. candidate.Name
	return true
end

local function requestFocus(candidate)
	focusSerial += 1
	local serial = focusSerial
	if focusWorker then pcall(task.cancel, focusWorker) end
	local stamp = nextFocusStamp()
	lastFocusAt = os.clock()
	focusWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "SetSpectate", candidate.UserId, stamp)
		if not alive or not watching or serial ~= focusSerial or target ~= candidate then return end
		focusWorker = nil
		if not ok or typeof(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then
			rejectedUntil[candidate.UserId] = os.clock() + 3
			task.delay(0.25, function() if alive and watching and serial == focusSerial then stepTarget(1) end end)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if alive and watching and serial == focusSerial and focusWorker then
			exitSpectate("Could not load the arena. Try again.")
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end

local function setTarget(candidate)
	target = candidate
	gui:SetAttribute("SpectatingUserId", candidate.UserId)
	panel.PlayerName.Text = candidate.DisplayName
	panel.Username.Text = "LOADING ARENA..."
	loadingUntil = os.clock() + 10
	requestFocus(candidate)
	applyTargetCamera(candidate)
end

stepTarget = function(direction)
	if not watching then return end
	if os.clock() - lastTargetChange < 0.25 then return end
	lastTargetChange = os.clock()
	local list = targetsFor(watchingGame)
	if #list == 0 then exitSpectate("No players left to watch.") return end
	local index = table.find(list, target)
	local nextIndex = index and ((index - 1 + direction) % #list + 1) or 1
	setTarget(list[nextIndex])
	panel.Counter.Text = string.format("%d / %d", nextIndex, #list)
end

local function startSpectate()
	if watching or inRound() or otherModalOpen() or not gui.Enabled then return end
	local gameId, roundNumber = activeRound()
	local list = targetsFor(gameId)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not gameId or #list == 0 or not camera then tell("No round to watch yet.") return end
	savedCamera = { subject = camera.CameraSubject, kind = camera.CameraType, cframe = camera.CFrame, focus = camera.Focus }
	local selected = GuiService.SelectedObject
	if not selected or not selected:IsDescendantOf(gui) then savedSelection = selected end
	watching = true
	lastTargetChange = -math.huge
	closeMenu()
	disableMovement()
	watchingGame = gameId
	watchingRound = roundNumber
	gui:SetAttribute("Spectating", true)
	panel.Visible = true
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(movementAction, function()
		return watching and Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink or Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 2,
		Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterForward, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterBackward,
		Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterLeft, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterRight, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterJump)
	stepTarget(1)
	if gamepadActive() then GuiService.SelectedObject = panel.Exit end
	refresh()
end

local function toggleAFK()
	if busy or not gui.Enabled then return end
	busy = true
	requestSerial += 1
	local serial = requestSerial
	refresh()
	requestWorker = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, response = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "SetAFK", player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") ~= true)
		if not alive or serial ~= requestSerial then return end
		requestWorker = nil
		busy = false
		if ok and typeof(response) == "table" then tell(response.message or "AFK updated.") else tell("Could not update AFK. Try again.") end
		refresh()
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if alive and busy and serial == requestSerial then
			requestSerial += 1
			busy = false
			if requestWorker then pcall(task.cancel, requestWorker) requestWorker = nil end
			tell("AFK request timed out. Try again.")
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end

refresh = function()
	if not alive then return end
	local modal = otherModalOpen()
	local participating = inRound()
	if modal or not gui.Enabled then closeMenu() end
	local gameId, roundNumber = activeRound()
	local localHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if watching then
		if participating or not gui.Enabled or modal or not localHumanoid or localHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
			exitSpectate()
		elseif not gameId or gameId ~= watchingGame or roundNumber ~= watchingRound then
			exitSpectate("The round has ended.")
		else
			disableMovement()
			local list = targetsFor(gameId)
			local index = table.find(list, target)
			if not index then
				stepTarget(1)
			else
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local humanoid = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if camera and humanoid and root then
					if camera.CameraSubject ~= humanoid or camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then applyTargetCamera(target) end
				elseif os.clock() >= loadingUntil then
					rejectedUntil[target.UserId] = os.clock() + 3
					stepTarget(1)
				end
				panel.Counter.Text = string.format("%d / %d", index, #list)
				if watching and target and not focusWorker and os.clock() - lastFocusAt >= 4 then requestFocus(target) end
			end
		end
	end
	dock.Visible = gui.Enabled and not modal and not watching and menuOpen
	backdrop.Visible = dock.Visible
	local compact, portrait = compactLayout()
	local showSettings = gui.Enabled and not modal and not participating
	toggle.Visible = showSettings and not compact
	compactToggle.Visible = showSettings and compact and not portrait
	portraitToggle.Visible = showSettings and compact and portrait
	local showRoundSettings = gui.Enabled and not modal and participating
	roundToggle.Visible = showRoundSettings and not compact
	compactRoundToggle.Visible = showRoundSettings and compact and not portrait
	portraitRoundToggle.Visible = showRoundSettings and compact and portrait
	panel.Visible = watching and not modal
	local requested = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") == true
	local queued = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKQueued") == true
	panel.JoinStatus.Text = requested and "AFK ON • STAYING IN LOBBY" or "YOU WILL JOIN THE NEXT ROUND"
	afkButton.Label.Text = queued and "AFK NEXT ROUND" or requested and "AFK: ON" or "AFK: OFF"
	buttonState(afkButton, not busy, requested)
	for _, launcher in ipairs(settingsLaunchers) do buttonState(launcher, true) end
	for _, launcher in ipairs(roundLaunchers) do buttonState(launcher, true) end
	local uiHidden = gui:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true
	visibilityButton.Label.Text = uiHidden and "SHOW UI" or "HIDE UI"
	buttonState(visibilityButton, true, uiHidden)
	local showWatch = gui.Enabled and not modal and not participating and not menuOpen
	watchButton.Visible = showWatch and not compact
	compactWatch.Visible = showWatch and compact and not portrait
	portraitWatch.Visible = showWatch and compact and portrait
	local canWatch = watching or (gameId ~= nil and #targetsFor(gameId) > 0)
	for _, launcher in ipairs(watchLaunchers) do
		launcher.Label.Text = watching and "STOP" or "SPECTATE"
		buttonState(launcher, canWatch)
	end
	watchButton.Label.Text = watching and "STOP WATCHING" or "SPECTATE"
	if os.clock() >= noticeUntil then
		content.Notice.Text = queued and "After this round" or requested and "Staying in the lobby" or ""
	end
	local controller = gamepadActive()
	content.Hint.Visible = controller
	content.Hint.Text = "D-PAD UP: SETTINGS  •  RIGHT: WATCH"
	panel.Controls.Text = controller and "L1 / R1: PLAYER   B / ○: EXIT" or "ARROWS: PLAYER   BACKSPACE: EXIT"
end

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(actionName, function(_, inputState, input)
	if not gui.Enabled or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or otherModalOpen() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight and not watching and not inRound() then
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then startSpectate() end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp then
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			local selected = GuiService.SelectedObject
			if not selected or not selected:IsDescendantOf(gui) then savedSelection = selected end
			if not watching then menuOpen = true gui:SetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen", true) refresh() end
			GuiService.SelectedObject = watching and panel.Exit or afkButton
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB and not watching then
		local selected = GuiService.SelectedObject
		if menuOpen or (selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(gui)) then
			if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then closeMenu() refresh() savedSelection = nil end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
	end
	if not watching then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB or key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then exitSpectate() refresh()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 or key == Enum.KeyCode.Left then stepTarget(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 or key == Enum.KeyCode.Right then stepTarget(1) end
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 2, Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp, Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1, Enum.KeyCode.Left, Enum.KeyCode.Right, Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)

local function fit()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	panel.Fit.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.25, (viewport.X - 32) / 460), math.max(0.25, (viewport.Y - 100) / 460))

local function buy(offer)
	if not panel.Visible or inRound() or pending then return end
	if commerce:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then panel.Status.Text = "Donations are not available right now." return end
	if not offer then panel.Status.Text = "That amount isn't available yet. Choose an available button." return end
	pending = offer.id
	panel.Status.Text = "Confirm your donation in the Roblox window."
	local ok = pcall(function() MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, offer.id) end)
	if not ok then pending = nil panel.Status.Text = "Roblox couldn't open the purchase. Please try again." end
end

local function loadOffers()
	if loading then return end
	loading = true
	table.clear(offers)
	panel.Status.Text = "Checking donation options..."
	for _, button in panel.Amounts:GetChildren() do
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then button.Active = false button:SetAttribute("ProductId", nil) end
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, entry in config:GetChildren() do
		if not entry:IsA("IntValue") or entry.Value <= 0 then continue end
		local ok, info = pcall(function() return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(entry.Value, Enum.InfoType.Product) end)
		if not ok or typeof(info) ~= "table" or info.IsForSale == false or typeof(info.PriceInRobux) ~= "number" or info.PriceInRobux < 1 then continue end
		local offer = { id = entry.Value, price = info.PriceInRobux }
		table.insert(offers, offer)
		count += 1
		local button = panel.Amounts:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)
		if button then
			button.Label.Text = tostring(offer.price) .. " ROBUX"
			button:SetAttribute("ProductId", offer.id)
			button.Active = true
		end
	end
	loading = false
	panel.Status.Text = count > 0 and "Every donation helps. Thank you!" or "Donations are coming soon."
end

for _, button in panel.Amounts:GetChildren() do
	if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local id = button:GetAttribute("ProductId")
			for _, offer in offers do if offer.id == id then buy(offer) return end end
			panel.Status.Text = "This donation option is not available yet."

local function remaining(expires, now)
	if typeof(expires) ~= "number" or expires ~= expires or math.abs(expires) == math.huge then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, math.ceil(expires - now))
end

end

		if screen and screen.Enabled then
			for _, child in ipairs(children) do

local function equippedBat()
	if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true
		or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true then return nil end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or player:GetAttribute("BBRagdolled") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGRagdolled") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSRagdolled") == true then return nil end
	local gameId
	if player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("BBRole") == "Bulldog" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BritishBulldogState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Crossing" then gameId = "BritishBulldog" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("TGRole") == "Tagger" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TagState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Playing" then gameId = "TagYoureIt" end
	elseif player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true and player:GetAttribute("HSRole") == "Seeker" then
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HideAndSeekState")
		if state and state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Seeking" then gameId = "HideAndSeek" end
	end
	if not gameId then return nil end
	for _, tool in character:GetChildren() do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Enabled and tool:GetAttribute("PCBatWeapon") == true
			and tool:GetAttribute("WeaponGame") == gameId then return tool end
	end
	return nil
end

local function remainingCooldown()
	local at = player:GetAttribute("PCBatSwingAt")
	local serverRemaining = typeof(at) == "number" and at > 0 and at + 0.75 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or 0
	return math.max(0, nextTapAt - os.clock(), serverRemaining)
end

local function refresh()
	local bat = equippedBat()
	button.Visible = bat ~= nil
	local ready = bat ~= nil and focused and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() and remainingCooldown() <= 0
	button.Active = ready
	button.Selectable = false
	skin.ImageColor3 = ready and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(164, 170, 184)
	button.Hint.Text = remainingCooldown() > 0 and string.format("%.1fs", remainingCooldown()) or "TAP"
	fallback.Visible = not skin.IsLoaded
end

local function swing()
	local bat = equippedBat()
	if not button.Visible or not gui.Enabled or not bat or not focused or GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or remainingCooldown() > 0 then return end
	nextTapAt = os.clock() + 0.75
	local ok = pcall(function()
		bat:Activate()
		bat:Deactivate()
	end)
	if not ok then nextTapAt = 0 end
	refresh()
end

local function connect(signal, callback)
	table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(callback))
end
connect(button.Activated, swing)
connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function() focused = false refresh() end)
connect(UserInputService.WindowFocused, function() focused = true refresh() end)
connect(UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TouchEnabled"), refresh)
connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function() nextTapAt = 0 button.Visible = false end)
connect(player.CharacterAdded, function() nextTapAt = 0 refresh() end)
connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(delta)
	elapsed += delta
	if elapsed >= 0.05 then elapsed = 0 refresh() end
end)
connect(script.Destroying, function()
	for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	button.Visible = false
end)
refresh()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = script.Parent
local state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundState")
local connections = {}
local elapsed = 0

local function render()
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
	local short = math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)
	local compact = viewport.X <= 900 or short <= 600
		or (short <= 1024 and math.max(viewport.X,viewport.Y) <= 1400)
	local portrait = compact and viewport.Y > viewport.X
	local participating = player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true
		or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or ( player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true )
	local shown = not participating and phase ~= "Playing"
	local shell = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundShell")
	local toast = shell and shell:FindFirstChild("RewardToast")
	local backdrop = shell and shell:FindFirstChild("Backdrop")
	local session = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlaygroundSessionControls")
	if backdrop and backdrop.Visible then shown = false end
	if session and (session:GetAttribute("UIHidden") == true or session:GetAttribute("SessionMenuOpen") == true) then shown = false end
	if compact and toast and toast.Visible then shown = false end
	for name, panels in pairs({ PlaygroundEmoteWheel = { "Panel" }, PlaygroundDonations = { "Panel" },
		PlaygroundAdminPanel = { "Panel", "CompactPanel", "AdminHub" } }) do
		local screen = gui.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if screen and screen.Enabled then
			for _, name in ipairs(panels) do
				local panel = screen:FindFirstChild(name)
				if panel and panel.Visible then shown = false end
			end
		end
	end
	local title, timer, detail = "NEXT ROUND", "", "Preparing the lobby..."
	local status = state:GetAttribute("IntermissionStatus")
	if phase == "Voting" then
		local endsAt = state:GetAttribute("VotingEndsAt")
		if typeof(endsAt) == "number" and endsAt == endsAt and math.abs(endsAt) < math.huge then
			local seconds = math.max(0,math.ceil(endsAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
			timer = string.format("%d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
		end
		title = "INTERMISSION"
		detail = status == "Next round starts in" and "Vote for the next game!" or status or "Vote for the next game!"
	elseif phase == "Paused" then
		title, detail = "ROUNDS PAUSED", "Automatic rounds paused by an admin"
	elseif phase == "Waiting" then
		title = "WAITING FOR PLAYERS"
		local count = state:GetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount") or 0
		local minimum = state:GetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers") or 2
		detail = typeof(status) == "string" and status ~= "" and status or string.format("%d / %d players ready",count,minimum)
	end
	local compactDetail = detail
	if phase == "Waiting" then
		compactDetail = typeof(status) == "string" and string.find(string.lower(status),"data",1,true)
			and "Loading player data" or string.format("Players ready: %d/%d",state:GetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount") or 0,state:GetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers") or 2)
	elseif phase == "Paused" then
		compactDetail = "Paused by an admin"
	elseif phase == "Voting" and status ~= nil and status ~= "Next round starts in" then
		compactDetail = "Retrying next round"
	end
	for _,card in {gui.Desktop,gui.Compact,gui.Portrait} do
		card.Visible = shown and (card == gui.Desktop and not compact
			or card == gui.Compact and compact and not portrait
			or card == gui.Portrait and portrait)
		card.Title.Text = card ~= gui.Desktop and phase == "Waiting" and "WAITING" or title
		card.Timer.Text = timer
		card.Detail.Text = card == gui.Desktop and detail or compactDetail
		card.Fallback.Visible = not card.ReusableSkin.IsLoaded
	end
end

table.insert(connections,state.AttributeChanged:Connect(render))
table.insert(connections,player.AttributeChanged:Connect(render))
table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed >= 0.1 then elapsed=0 render() end
end))
table.insert(connections,script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
end))
render()

		slot = slot,
		available = true,

		unlock = { kind = kind, amount = amount, gameId = gameId },
		description = description,
		color = Color3.fromRGB(color[1], color[2], color[3]),
		assetId = id,
	}
end

	TagStart = { game = "TagYoureIt" }, TagRunner = { game = "TagYoureIt", role = "Runner" }, TagTagger = { game = "TagYoureIt", role = "Tagger" },

}
controls.HSStart = { game = "HideAndSeek" }
local aliases = { StartRound = "BBStart", PracticeRunner = "BBRunner", PracticeBulldog = "BBBulldog" }
local grants = { GrantItem = true, GrantCoins = true, AddLevels = true, GrantVIP = true, GrantBetaTester = true }

function Admin.new(coordinator, config, isStudio, playerSource)
	return setmetatable({ coordinator = coordinator, config = config, isStudio = isStudio, players = playerSource or Players, lastRequest = {}, lastStatus = {}, busy = false, connections = {} }, Admin)
end

function Admin:IsAuthorized(player)
	local userId = player and player.UserId
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or userId <= 0 or userId % 1 ~= 0 or userId >= 9007199254740991 then return false end
	if userId == self.config:GetAttribute("AdminUserId") then return true end
	local extraIds = self.config:GetAttribute("ExtraAdminUserIds")
	if typeof(extraIds) ~= "string" then return false end
	for token in extraIds:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local digits = token:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
		if digits and tonumber(digits) == userId then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function Admin:_target(player, payload)
	if payload ~= nil and typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return nil, "Choose a player in this server." end
	local id = player.UserId
	if payload and payload.targetUserId ~= nil then id = payload.targetUserId end
	if typeof(id) ~= "number" or id ~= id or id % 1 ~= 0 or id == 0 or math.abs(id) > 1000000000000 or (id < 0 and not self.isStudio) then
		return nil, "Choose a player in this server."
	end
	local target = self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
	if not target then return nil, "That player is no longer in this server." end
	return target
end

function Admin:Status(player, ok, message, target)
	local active = self.coordinator:ActiveGame()
	local service = active and self.coordinator.services[active]
	local reply = { ok = ok, message = message or "", game = active or "", phase = service and service.phase or "Waiting", mode = service and service.state:GetAttribute("Mode") or "Waiting", role = active == "HideAndSeek" and player:GetAttribute("HSRole") or active == "StuckInTheMud" and (player:GetAttribute("MDMuddy") and "Stuck" or "Free") or active == "TagYoureIt" and player:GetAttribute("TGRole") or player:GetAttribute("BBRole"), automatic = self.coordinator.autoEnabled }
	reply.players = {}
	for _, online in ipairs(self.players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(reply.players, { userId = online.UserId, name = online.Name, displayName = online.DisplayName, ready = online:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true })
	end
	table.sort(reply.players, function(a, b)
		if a.name == b.name then return a.userId < b.userId end
		return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
	end)
	local economy = self.coordinator.economy
	if economy then
		reply.limits = table.clone(economy.AdminLimits)
		if target == false then target = nil
		else target = target or self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId) end
		if target then
			reply.targetUserId = target.UserId
			reply.target = economy:Status(target, true)
			reply.target.userId = target.UserId
			reply.target.name = target.Name
			reply.target.displayName = target.DisplayName
		end
	end
	return reply
end

function Admin:Handle(player, action, payload)
	if not self:IsAuthorized(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Admin access required." } end
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then return self:Status(player, false, "Unknown control.") end
	action = aliases[action] or action
	if not controls[action] and not grants[action] and action ~= "StopRound" and action ~= "GetStatus" and action ~= "ToggleAutomatic" then return self:Status(player, false, "Unknown control.") end
	local target, targetError
	if grants[action] or action == "GetStatus" then
		if grants[action] and (typeof(payload) ~= "table" or payload.targetUserId == nil) then return self:Status(player, false, "Choose a target player for this action.") end
		target, targetError = self:_target(player, payload)
		if not target then return self:Status(player, false, targetError, false) end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local timestamps = action == "GetStatus" and self.lastStatus or self.lastRequest
	if now - (timestamps[player] or -math.huge) < (action == "GetStatus" and 0.1 or 0.5) then return self:Status(player, false, "Please wait a moment.", target) end
	timestamps[player] = now
	if action == "GetStatus" then return self:Status(player, true, "Ready to play.", target) end
	if self.busy then return self:Status(player, false, "Another control is finishing.", target) end
	self.busy = true
	local ok, success, message = pcall(function()
		if grants[action] then
			local economy = self.coordinator.economy
			if not economy then return false, "The player economy is not ready." end
			if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return false, "Choose an item or grant amount." end
			if action == "GrantItem" then
				return economy:AdminGrantItem(target, payload.itemId, payload.equip)
			end
			if action == "GrantCoins" then return economy:AdminGrantCoins(target, payload.amount) end
			if action == "AddLevels" then return economy:AdminAddLevels(target, payload.amount) end
			if action == "GrantVIP" then return economy:AdminGrantEntitlement(target, "VIP") end
			if action == "GrantBetaTester" then return economy:AdminGrantEntitlement(target, "BetaTester") end
		end
		if action == "StopRound" then return self.coordinator:StopGame() end
		if action == "ToggleAutomatic" then
			self.coordinator:SetAutoEnabled(not self.coordinator.autoEnabled)
			return true, self.coordinator.autoEnabled and "Automatic voting rounds are on." or "Automatic rounds paused."
		end
		local control = controls[action]
		local started, reason = self.coordinator:StartGame(control.game, player, control.role, false)
		if not started and reason == "Not enough ready players" then reason = "Use a solo button to test alone. Normal rounds need two players." end
		return started, started and "Starting your game." or reason
	end)
	self.busy = false
	if not ok then
		warn("Playground admin command failed: " .. tostring(success))
		return self:Status(player, false, "That admin action could not finish. Try again.", target)
	end
	if success and grants[action] then print("Playground admin " .. player.UserId .. " used " .. action .. " for " .. target.UserId) end
	return self:Status(player, success == true, message, target)
end

function Admin.Start(coordinator)
	local config = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundAdminConfig")
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundAdminRequest")
	local self = Admin.new(coordinator, config, RunService:IsStudio())
	self.remote = remote
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, payload) return self:Handle(player, action, payload) end
	local function bind(player) player:SetAttribute("PlaygroundAdmin", self:IsAuthorized(player)) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind))
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self.lastRequest[player] = nil self.lastStatus[player] = nil end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(player) end
	table.insert(self.connections, config.AttributeChanged:Connect(function() for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(player) end end))
	return self
end

function Admin:Destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	if self.remote then self.remote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
end

return Admin

function Coordinator.new(services, lobby, economy)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Coordinator)
	self.services = services
	self.lobby = lobby
	self.economy = economy
	self.zone = lobby.Gameplay.VoteZone
	self.state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundState")
	self.votes = {}
	self.lastVote = {}
	self.lastSessionRequest = {}
	self.sessionConnections = {}
	self.spectators = {}
	self.lastSpectateStamp = {}
	self.lastSpectateRequest = {}
	self.connections = {}
	self.running = false
	self.autoEnabled = true
	self.votingEndsAt = 0
	self.startRetryAt = 0
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.lastGame = nil
	return self
end

function Coordinator:ActiveGame()
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self.services[id] and self.services[id].active then return id end end
	return nil
end

function Coordinator:_participating(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("BBParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("TGParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("MDParticipating") == true or player:GetAttribute("HSParticipating") == true
end

function Coordinator:_afkRequested(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") == true or player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") == true
end

function Coordinator:_syncAFK(player)
	local requested = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKRequested") == true
	local participating = self:_participating(player)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", requested and not participating)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", requested and participating)
	if participating then self:_clearSpectate(player) end
end

function Coordinator:_clearSpectate(player)
	local entry = self.spectators[player]
	if not entry then return end
	self.spectators[player] = nil
	pcall(player.RemoveReplicationFocus, player, entry.root)
end

function Coordinator:_spectateTarget(player, userId)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or self:_participating(player) then return nil end
	local active = self:ActiveGame()
	local service = active and self.services[active]
	local phase = service and service.state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	if not service or phase == "Waiting" or phase == "Results" or phase == "Intermission" then return nil end
	local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local attribute = ({ BritishBulldog = "BBParticipating", TagYoureIt = "TGParticipating", StuckInTheMud = "MDParticipating", HideAndSeek = "HSParticipating" })[active]
	local character = target and target.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if target == player or not target or not target:GetAttribute(attribute) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return nil end
	return target, root
end

function Coordinator:SetSpectate(player, userId, stamp)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if player.Parent ~= Players or typeof(stamp) ~= "number" or stamp ~= stamp or math.abs(stamp - now) > 30
		or stamp <= (self.lastSpectateStamp[player] or -math.huge) then return { ok = false, message = "Expired spectate request." } end
	self.lastSpectateStamp[player] = stamp
	if userId == 0 then self:_clearSpectate(player) return { ok = true } end
	if typeof(userId) ~= "number" or userId ~= userId or userId % 1 ~= 0 then return { ok = false, message = "Invalid player." } end
	if now - (self.lastSpectateRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.2 then return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." } end
	self.lastSpectateRequest[player] = now
	local target, root = self:_spectateTarget(player, userId)
	if not target then self:_clearSpectate(player) return { ok = false, message = "That player is no longer in the round." } end
	local entry = self.spectators[player]
	if not entry or entry.root ~= root then
		self:_clearSpectate(player)
		local ok = pcall(player.AddReplicationFocus, player, root)
		if not ok then return { ok = false, message = "Could not load that arena. Try again." } end
		entry = { userId = userId, root = root }
		self.spectators[player] = entry
	end
	entry.expiresAt = now + 12
	return { ok = true, position = root.Position }
end

function Coordinator:_updateSpectators()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for player, entry in pairs(self.spectators) do
		local target, root = self:_spectateTarget(player, entry.userId)
		local ownHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not target or root ~= entry.root or now >= entry.expiresAt or not ownHumanoid or ownHumanoid.Health <= 0 then self:_clearSpectate(player) end
	end
end

function Coordinator:SetAFK(player, enabled)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or typeof(enabled) ~= "boolean" then
		return { ok = false, message = "Invalid AFK request." }
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.lastSessionRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.4 then
		return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." }
	end
	self.lastSessionRequest[player] = now
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", enabled)
	self:_syncAFK(player)
	if enabled then
		self.votes[player] = nil
		if self.padChoices then self.padChoices[player] = nil end
		player:SetAttribute("PCVote", "")
		self:_counts()
	end
	return {
		ok = true,
		afk = player:GetAttribute("PCAFK") == true,
		queued = player:GetAttribute("PCAFKQueued") == true,
		requested = enabled,
		message = enabled and (self:_participating(player) and "AFK after this round." or "AFK on. You will stay in the lobby.") or "AFK off. You can join the next round.",
	}
end

function Coordinator:_watchSessionPlayer(player)
	if self.sessionConnections[player] then return end
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", false)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", false)
	player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", false)
	local connections = {}
	self.sessionConnections[player] = connections
	for _, name in ipairs({ "BBParticipating", "TGParticipating", "MDParticipating", "HSParticipating" }) do
		table.insert(connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			self:_syncAFK(player)
		end))
	end
end

function Coordinator:_readyPlayers()
	local list = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not self:_afkRequested(player) and not self:_participating(player) and player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") == true then
			table.insert(list, player)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function Coordinator:MinimumPlayers(id)
	local service=self.services[id]
	local minimum=service and service.arena and service.arena:GetAttribute("MinimumPlayers")
	if typeof(minimum)~="number" or minimum~=minimum or math.abs(minimum)==math.huge then minimum=id=="StuckInTheMud" and 4 or 2 end
	return math.max(2,math.floor(minimum))
end

function Coordinator:GameAvailable(id, readyCount)
	local service=self.services[id]
	if not service or service.running == false then return false end
	if id=="StuckInTheMud" and service.state:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady")==false then return false end
	return (readyCount or #self:_readyPlayers())>=self:MinimumPlayers(id)
end

function Coordinator:_availability(readyCount)
	self.state:SetAttribute("ReadyPlayerCount",readyCount)
	for _,id in ipairs(games) do
	 self.state:SetAttribute("Available"..id,self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount))
	 if self.services[id] then self.state:SetAttribute("Minimum"..id,self:MinimumPlayers(id)) end
	end
end

function Coordinator:_insideZone(player)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return false end
	local point = self.zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local half = self.zone.Size / 2
	return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z
end

function Coordinator:_counts()
	local counts = { BritishBulldog = 0, TagYoureIt = 0, StuckInTheMud = 0, HideAndSeek = 0 }
	for player, id in pairs(self.votes) do
		if player.Parent == Players and not self:_afkRequested(player) and counts[id] then counts[id] += 1 end
	end
	for id, count in pairs(counts) do self.state:SetAttribute("Votes" .. id, count) end
	return counts
end

function Coordinator:_clearVotes()
	for player in pairs(self.votes) do if player.Parent == Players then player:SetAttribute("PCVote", "") end end
	table.clear(self.votes)
	self:_counts()
end

function Coordinator:SetAutoEnabled(enabled)
	self.autoEnabled = enabled == true
	self.votingEndsAt = 0
	self.startRetryAt = 0
	self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", self.autoEnabled and "Waiting for ready players" or "Automatic rounds paused by an admin")
	self.state:SetAttribute("AutomaticRounds", self.autoEnabled)
	self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
	if not self:ActiveGame() then
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", self.autoEnabled and "Waiting" or "Paused")
		self:_clearVotes()
	end
end

function Coordinator:Vote(player, id)
	if typeof(id) ~= "string" or not self.services[id] then return { ok = false, message = "Choose an available game." } end
	if self.state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Voting" or self:ActiveGame() or not self.autoEnabled then return { ok = false, message = "Voting opens between rounds." } end
	if self:_afkRequested(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Turn AFK off before voting." } end
	if player:GetAttribute("PCDataReady") ~= true then return { ok = false, message = "Your player data is loading." } end
	if not self:GameAvailable(id) then return {ok=false,message="This game is not ready for the next round."} end
	if self:_participating(player) or not self:_insideZone(player) then return { ok = false, message = "Walk into the voting area first." } end
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return { ok = false, message = "Your character is loading." } end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.lastVote[player] or -math.huge) < 0.35 then return { ok = false, message = "Please wait a moment." } end
	self.lastVote[player] = now
	self.votes[player] = id
	player:SetAttribute("PCVote", id)
	self:_counts()
	return { ok = true, message = "Vote saved." }
end

function Coordinator:StartGame(id, player, role, automatic)
	local service = self.services[id]
	if not service then return false, "This game is not available yet." end
	if self:ActiveGame() then return false, "A game is running. Stop it first." end
	if role and (not player or self:_afkRequested(player)) then return false, "Turn AFK off before starting practice." end
	local started, reason
	if role and not service.StartPractice then return false, "This game requires a normal round." end
	if role then started, reason = service:StartPractice(player, role)
	else started, reason = service:StartRound(self:_readyPlayers()) end
	if started then
		self.votingEndsAt = 0
		self.startRetryAt = 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "")
		self:_clearVotes()
		self.lastGame = id
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", id)
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", titles[id])
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Playing")
	end
	return started, reason
end

function Coordinator:StopGame()
	local stopped = false
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do
		if self.services[id] and self.services[id].active then self.services[id]:StopRound() stopped = true end
	end
	self:SetAutoEnabled(false)
	self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
	return true, stopped and "Back in the lobby." or "Ready in the lobby."
end

function Coordinator:_chooseGame()
	local counts = self:_counts()
	local readyCount=#self:_readyPlayers()
	local maximum = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount) then maximum = math.max(maximum, counts[id]) end end
	local tied = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do if self:GameAvailable(id,readyCount) and counts[id] == maximum then table.insert(tied, id) end end
	if maximum == 0 and self.lastGame then
		for _, id in ipairs(tied) do if id ~= self.lastGame then return id end end
	end
	return #tied>0 and tied[self.random:NextInteger(1, #tied)] or nil
end

function Coordinator:_rewardBulldog()
	local service = self.services.BritishBulldog
	if service.phase ~= "Results" then return end
	local state = service.state
	local team = state:GetAttribute("WinnerTeam")
	if team ~= "Runners" and team ~= "Bulldogs" then return end
	local winnerIds, participantIds = {}, {}
	for player, record in pairs(service.records) do
		if not record.isBot and record.participating and player.Parent == Players then
			table.insert(participantIds, player.UserId)
			if (team == "Runners" and record.role == "Runner") or (team == "Bulldogs" and record.role == "Bulldog") then table.insert(winnerIds, player.UserId) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(winnerIds)
	table.sort(participantIds)
	self.economy:AwardRound("BB:" .. tostring(state:GetAttribute("RoundNumber")), winnerIds, string.find(state:GetAttribute("Mode") or "", "Practice", 1, true) ~= nil, participantIds, { gameId = "BritishBulldog" })
end

function Coordinator:_rewardTag()
	local state = self.services.TagYoureIt.state
	local ids, participants = {}, {}
	for value in string.gmatch(state:GetAttribute("LastResultWinnerIds") or "", "%-?%d+") do table.insert(ids, tonumber(value)) end
	for value in string.gmatch(state:GetAttribute("LastResultParticipantIds") or "", "%-?%d+") do table.insert(participants, tonumber(value)) end
	self.economy:AwardRound("TAG:" .. tostring(state:GetAttribute("LastResultRound")), ids, state:GetAttribute("LastResultPractice") == true, participants, { gameId = "TagYoureIt" })
end

function Coordinator:_padVoting()
 self.padChoices=self.padChoices or {}
 if self.state:GetAttribute("Phase")~="Voting" then table.clear(self.padChoices) return end
 local choices=self.lobby.Gameplay:FindFirstChild("VoteChoices")
 if not choices then return end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local choice
  if root and not self:_afkRequested(player) and self:_insideZone(player) then
   for _,pad in ipairs(choices:GetChildren()) do
    if pad:IsA("BasePart") and pad:GetAttribute("Available")~=false then
     local point=pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
     local half=pad.Size/2
     if math.abs(point.X)<=half.X and math.abs(point.Y)<=half.Y and math.abs(point.Z)<=half.Z then choice=pad:GetAttribute("GameId") break end
    end
   end
  end
  if choice and not self:GameAvailable(choice) then choice=nil end
  if choice~=self.padChoices[player] then
   self.padChoices[player]=choice
   if choice then self:Vote(player,choice) end
  end
 end
end

function Coordinator:_step(now)
	self:_updateSpectators()
	local active = self:ActiveGame()
	local readyCount = #self:_readyPlayers()
	self:_availability(readyCount)
	local minimum, available = math.huge, false
	for _, id in ipairs(games) do
		local service = self.services[id]
		if service and service.running ~= false and not (id == "StuckInTheMud" and service.state:GetAttribute("GunAccessReady") == false) then
			minimum = math.min(minimum, self:MinimumPlayers(id))
			available = available or self:GameAvailable(id, readyCount)
		end
	end
	if minimum == math.huge then minimum = 2 end
	self.state:SetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers", minimum)
	if active then
		self.votingEndsAt, self.startRetryAt = 0, 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Playing")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", active)
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", titles[active])
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "")
	elseif not self.autoEnabled then
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Paused")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Automatic rounds paused by an admin")
	elseif not available then
		self.votingEndsAt, self.startRetryAt = 0, 0
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", readyCount < minimum
			and string.format("Waiting for ready players (%d/%d)", readyCount, minimum)
			or "Waiting for an available game")
		self:_clearVotes()
	elseif self.votingEndsAt == 0 then
		self:_clearVotes()
		self.votingEndsAt = now + INTERMISSION_SECONDS
		self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Voting")
		self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("GameTitle", "")
		self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", self.votingEndsAt)
		self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Next round starts in")
		self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	elseif now >= self.votingEndsAt and now >= self.startRetryAt then
		local selected = self:_chooseGame()
		local ok, started, reason = pcall(self.StartGame, self, selected, nil, nil, true)
		if not ok or not started then
			local failure = tostring(ok and reason or started)
			self.startRetryAt = now + START_RETRY_SECONDS
			self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Preparing the next round - retrying")
			self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", failure)
			warn("Automatic round could not start: " .. failure)
		end
	end
	self:_padVoting()
end

function Coordinator:_loop()
	while self.running do
		self:_step(workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end

function Coordinator:Start()
	if self.running then return end
	self.running = true
	self.state:SetAttribute("AutomaticRounds", self.autoEnabled)
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionSeconds", INTERMISSION_SECONDS)
	self.state:SetAttribute("MinimumReadyPlayers", 2)
	self.state:SetAttribute("IntermissionStatus", "Waiting for ready players")
	self.state:SetAttribute("LastRoundStartError", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	self.state:SetAttribute("ActiveGame", "")
	self.state:SetAttribute("VotingEndsAt", 0)
	self:_counts()
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundVoteRequest")
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id) return self:Vote(player, id) end
	self.remote = remote
	local sessionRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaygroundSessionRequest")
	sessionRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, value, stamp)
		if action == "SetSpectate" then return self:SetSpectate(player, value, stamp) end
		if action ~= "SetAFK" then return { ok = false, message = "Invalid session request." } end
		return self:SetAFK(player, value)
	end
	self.sessionRemote = sessionRemote
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:_watchSessionPlayer(player) end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:_watchSessionPlayer(player) end
	table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self.votes[player] = nil
		self.lastVote[player] = nil
		self.lastSessionRequest[player] = nil
		self:_clearSpectate(player)
		self.lastSpectateStamp[player] = nil
		self.lastSpectateRequest[player] = nil
		for _, connection in ipairs(self.sessionConnections[player] or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
		self.sessionConnections[player] = nil
		self:_counts()
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.services.BritishBulldog.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function() self:_rewardBulldog() end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.services.TagYoureIt.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardTag() end))
	if self.services.StuckInTheMud then table.insert(self.connections,self.services.StuckInTheMud.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardMud() end)) end
	if self.services.HideAndSeek then table.insert(self.connections, self.services.HideAndSeek.state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastResultRound"):Connect(function() self:_rewardHideAndSeek() end)) end
	task.spawn(function() self:_loop() end)
end

function Coordinator:Stop()
	self.running = false
	self:StopGame()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	if self.remote then self.remote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
	if self.sessionRemote then self.sessionRemote.OnServerInvoke = nil end
	for player in pairs(self.spectators) do self:_clearSpectate(player) end
	table.clear(self.lastSpectateStamp)
	table.clear(self.lastSpectateRequest)
	for player, connections in pairs(self.sessionConnections) do
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		if player.Parent == Players then
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFKRequested", false)
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFK", false)
			player:SetAttribute("PCAFKQueued", false)
		end
	end
	table.clear(self.sessionConnections)
	table.clear(self.lastSessionRequest)
end

return Coordinator

local function boundedInteger(value, minimum, maximum)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value % 1 == 0 and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end

local function integer(value, fallback)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return fallback end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000000)
end

local function timestamp(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000000000)
end

end
